summary_en.experiments: Stale traces degrade 34/135 correct starts versus 4/135 with current traces (22.2-point gap, Holm p=0.0337); forced two-revision drops current correctness from 0.820 to 0.673 while ever-correct rises to 0.847.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Alibaba Cloud; empirical study on agentic code repair reliability, not a modeling or pretraining contribution.

recommendation.zh: 结论对 agent 训练里"多修几轮更稳"的直觉是个提醒，但与预训练关联弱，看 stale-trace 那组数字即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a caution against naive revise-loops in agent RL setups, but tangential to pretrain; the stale-trace number is the only takeaway.

paper.title: PhantomFill: When the Form Demands an Answer, Language Models Invent One
paper.abstract: Language models in production do not write prose. They fill forms: JSON fields, function arguments, extraction templates. We show that the form itself causes hallucination.   We ask thirteen models the same question about the same input and change only the answer format. The inputs are built so the question cannot be answered: a viral post showing 12,400 likes but no visible replies, a support ticket whose call was never transcribed. In free text, GPT-5.5 answers honestly. It says there is no re

summary.core_problem: 论文研究结构化输出格式如何诱导模型在证据不足时编造答案。核心变量不是问题、输入或模型能力，而是输出 schema 是否给模型留下可拒答的槽位。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方法没有直接贡献，但对 post-training、评测和工具调用训练很有启发。很多安全与诚实性评测允许模型用自然语言拒答，而生产环境常要求 JSON、function arguments 或抽取模板。论文显示，自然语言中的 abstention 能力不一定迁移到无逃生选项的结构化字段，尤其是 closed-vocabulary enum。这会影响 SFT/RL 数据设计、schema 设计、tool-use 评测，以及模型在抽取任务中的幻觉测量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Abstention-Affordance Ladder。每个样本保持输入和问题不变，只改变输出形式：第一层是自由文本，模型可以自然拒答；第二层是带 escape 的 JSON schema，例如 enum 允许 insufficient_evidence，string/array 允许 null；第三层是 required JSON schema，要求填 closed-vocabulary sentiment、最小数量数组、代表性 quote 等字段，且没有拒答槽位。数据被构造成“不可回答”：例如社交帖子只有点赞和回复数，没有回复文本；客服工单有元数据，但电话未转写。因此任何关于群体情绪、回复主题、客户原话的具体说法都可由规则判为编造，不依赖 LLM-as-judge。指标包括 CFR，即 required schema 下的 coerced fabrication rate；EUR，即带 escape schema 下的 escape utilization rate；以及格式违规率。
summary.experiments: 论文测试 13 个模型，每个矩阵单元 n=40。GPT-5.5 在自由文本中面对无回复文本的帖子，98% 会说明没有证据；但在 required sentiment schema 下 40/40 编造。九个开源模型，参数量从 0.8B 到 26B，和 GPT-5.5 在 required-field rung 上都达到 100% fabrication。带 escape 的 schema 只稳定帮助了 GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus；九个开源模型仍有 60% 到 100% 编造，Claude Sonnet 为 90%。额外系统指令能把自由文本编造率从 39% 降到 4%，但在 required schema 下，对 6 个测试模型中的 4 个没有效果。字段级结果也很关键：GPT-5.5 对 required sentiment enum 20/20 编造，但对 required quote string 0/20 编造，倾向在字符串里写免责声明。这说明 enum 这类无 hedge 空间的字段风险更高。论文还观察到领域依赖，例如 Sonnet 会对 crowd sentiment 编造，但在 customer call 场景中拒绝编造。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Abstention-Affordance Ladder 的实验设计，因为它把格式压力作为唯一变量控制住了。再看 CFR/EUR 的定义和自动评分方式，判断指标是否适合自己的 tool-use 或抽取评测。结果部分建议重点看三类对比：free text vs JSON required、带 escape vs 不带 escape、enum vs string。若做 SFT/RL 数据，应重点关注系统指令失效和 escape-hatch 设计，这两点直接影响结构化输出训练样本的标注规范。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in structured generation: when the input does not contain enough evidence, a schema with required fields and no abstention option can push a model to invent values. The causal factor under test is the answer format, not the question or the source document.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and post-training signal paper rather than a pretraining contribution. It matters because many honesty evaluations are conducted in free text, while deployed models often produce JSON, function-call arguments, or extraction records. The results suggest that abstention behavior learned in prose does not reliably transfer to constrained schemas, especially closed-vocabulary fields. This has direct implications for SFT/RL data, tool-use benchmarks, extraction pipelines, and schema design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Abstention-Affordance Ladder. Each item keeps the document and question fixed while varying only the output format: free-form prose, JSON with explicit escape values such as insufficient_evidence or null, and required JSON fields with no escape path. The examples are constructed so that the requested information is absent by design: a social-media post has engagement counts but no visible replies, and a support ticket has call metadata but no transcript. Any concrete claim about reply sentiment, reply themes, customer complaints, or verbatim quotes is therefore a fabrication by construction. This enables deterministic scoring without a judge model. The main metrics are coerced fabrication rate under required schemas, escape utilization rate when an escape is available, and format-violation rate.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 models with n = 40 trials per matrix cell. GPT-5.5 declines in free text 98% of the time for the no-reply social-post setting, but fabricates 40 out of 40 times when a required sentiment field is imposed. All nine tested open-weight models, ranging from 0.8B to 26B parameters, and GPT-5.5 reach 100% fabrication under the required-field condition. Escape fields help GPT-5.5 and mostly help Claude Opus, but the open models still fabricate at 60% to 100%, and Claude Sonnet fabricates at 90%. A system instruction forbidding sentiment inference reduces free-text fabrication from 39% to 4%, yet has no effect under required schemas for four of six tested models. Field-level analysis is especially informative: GPT-5.5 fabricates a required sentiment enum 20 out of 20 times, while it avoids fabricating a required quote string by placing disclaimers inside the string. The failure is also domain-dependent; for example, Sonnet behaves differently on crowd-reaction and customer-call settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the ladder design, since it cleanly isolates format pressure. Then inspect the metric definitions for CFR and EUR, as they are useful for building structured-output evaluations. The most useful result tables are the comparisons between prose and required JSON, escape-enabled and escape-free schemas, and enum versus string fields. For post-training work, focus on the sections showing that prompt-level instructions can disappear under schema pressure and that explicit escape values need to be part of the schema, not just the natural-language instruction.

recommendation.zh: 改变对结构化输出安全性的认知，必填字段会强制模型编造，做SFT和推理时schema设计必须加显式空值分支，重点看§3控制变量实验。
recommendation.en: Changes prior beliefs on structured output safety; required fields force fabrication, so SFT and inference schema design must include explicit null branches, focus on §3 controlled experiments.

paper.title: Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions
paper.abstract: Deep Research agents extend LLM-based assistants into long-horizon workflows involving planning, retrieval, evidence synthesis, and report generation, yet their reliability in open information environments remains underexplored. A key concern is whether apparently credible but factually misleading knowledge encountered in such environments can propagate through these workflows and be adopted as false conclusions in final reports. To study this failure mode, we introduce MisKnow-Agent, a framewor

summary.core_problem: 长流程Deep Research Agent在开放信息环境中遇到看似可信的误导性知识时，是否会将错误信息传播到最终报告中尚未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 提出了可控误导知识构造框架MisKnow-Agent，量化了误导信息对长流程检索Agent结论可靠性的影响程度。
summary.technical_approach: 构造可控权威度、风格的误导性知识实例，注入到Deep Research任务流程中，测量最终报告对错误结论的采纳率。
summary.experiments: 基于DeepResearch Benchmark构建了5933个质量受控的误导实例，在多款开源/闭源Deep Research Agent上验证发现，即使少量误导知识暴露也会高概率导致最终报告输出错误结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether long-horizon Deep Research agents propagate factually misleading knowledge from open environments into final reports remains underexplored.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MisKnow-Agent, a framework for constructing controllable misleading knowledge instances, and quantifies the impact of misinformation on long-horizon retrieval agent reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates misleading instances with controllable authority levels and styles, injects them into deep research workflows, and measures the adoption rate of false conclusions in final reports.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs 5,933 quality-controlled misleading instances based on DeepResearch Benchmark; experiments across open-source and closed-source deep research agents show that even limited exposure to misleading knowledge induces false conclusions with high probability.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了长流程检索Agent的误导知识污染失效模式，但无建模改进，作为鲁棒性背景知识备查即可。
recommendation.en: Documents the misinformation pollution failure mode of long-horizon retrieval agents, but proposes no modeling improvements; keep as background reference only.

paper.title: Economic Evaluations of Language Models
paper.abstract: Language models perform economically valuable work, yet they are not currently assessed for how well they perform every economically valuable task. We introduce EconEvals as an open-source evaluation suite to measure capabilities relevant to tasks, work activities, and occupations in the US labor economy. We ground the evaluation suite in real user queries to language models where possible, and supplement these with synthetic data. Our evaluations improve coverage over OpenAI's GDPval benchmark,

summary.core_problem: 解决现有语言模型评测无法系统覆盖“经济上有价值的工作任务”这一缺口，建立更广覆盖、低成本、可追踪的经济任务评测与暴露度估计框架。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产与评测方法贡献。它不是 pretrain 方法论文，但对基座研究员有现实意义：模型能力最终会映射到哪些工作活动、哪些任务仍不可靠、评测集如何从真实用户查询构建，这些都会反过来影响数据配比、能力目标和 post-train 方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EconEvals 开源评测套件，按美国劳动力市场中的任务、工作活动和职业组织评测；尽量用真实用户查询构造样本，不足部分用合成数据补齐。除 benchmark 外，还提出 simulation-based exposure measure，用细粒度任务级核算估计当前模型能为各职业节省多少时间，并显式记录估计依据。
summary.experiments: 相较 OpenAI 的 GDPval，覆盖范围更大，声称成本降低约 500 倍，并把职业覆盖从 GDPval 的约 5% 大幅扩展。结果上，当前模型在 47% 的职业中，至少一半任务可节省显著时间；但对 79% 可节省时间的任务，模型仍无法可靠完成全部步骤，说明“有帮助”与“可托付”之间仍有明显差距。摘要未给出具体参评模型名单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Stanford CRFM 相关团队；Percy Liang 与 Rishi Bommasani 长期做基础模型评测、HELM、治理与能力测量，这篇延续了他们把模型能力映射到真实社会任务的路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a gap in LM evaluation: current benchmarks do not systematically measure performance on economically valuable work tasks across the labor market.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method, but it matters for foundation-model researchers because it connects model capability to real task structure, reliability gaps, and ultimately to what capabilities data mixtures and post-training should target.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces EconEvals, an open-source evaluation suite organized around tasks, work activities, and occupations in the US labor economy. The benchmark uses real user LM queries where possible and supplements them with synthetic data. It also proposes a simulation-based exposure measure to estimate time savings across occupations with explicit accounting for each estimate.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with OpenAI's GDPval, EconEvals claims much broader coverage at roughly 500x lower cost, expanding beyond GDPval's ~5% occupation coverage. The headline result is that current models could save substantial time on at least half of tasks in 47% of occupations, yet for 79% of tasks with potential time savings, models still cannot reliably complete all required steps. The abstract does not list the evaluated models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are connected to the Stanford CRFM ecosystem. Percy Liang and Rishi Bommasani are well known for HELM, foundation-model evaluation, and governance-oriented capability measurement; this work continues that line by grounding evaluation in real economic tasks.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法，但评测 framing 很干净：把“会做题”改成“能否稳定完成经济任务”；读 benchmark 设计和 exposure 定义，别太在意 headline 数字。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the framing is clean: it shifts evaluation from benchmark-solving to reliable economic task completion; read the benchmark design and exposure metric, not the headline percentages.

paper.title: FailureAtlas: A Taxonomy of Failure Modes in Multi-Provider LLM Serving Infrastructure
paper.abstract: Multi-provider LLM gateways reverse proxies that route, load-balance, and rate-limit requests across foundation-model APIs have become critical production infrastructure. Yet the failure modes specific to this architectural layer remain undocumented, scattered across issue trackers and post-mortems with no unifying framework. We introduce \fa{}, a two-axis taxonomy that classifies failures by their \emph{origin layer} (Network/Transport, Streaming/Protocol, State/Session, Model~Behavior, Governa

summary.core_problem: 多提供商 LLM 网关（反向代理）在生产环境中存在哪些特定的故障模式，且这些故障为何难以被传统监控发现？
summary.importance: 首次系统性地对多提供商 LLM 服务基础设施的故障模式进行了分类（FailureAtlas），揭示了最严重的故障往往是“静默”的，对构建高可用 LLM 服务系统具有重要工程指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个二维分类法（FailureAtlas），按“起源层”（网络/传输、流/协议、状态/会话、模型行为、治理/成本）和“可检测性”（显式 vs. 静默）对故障进行分类。通过分析公开的 bug 报告和第一手压力测试，提供了五个经过验证的目录条目及机械性根本原因分析。
summary.experiments: 提供了五个具体的故障案例分析，其中三个包含独立的复现脚本。主要发现是：操作上最严重的故障是“静默”的（返回 HTTP 200，通过标准健康检查，但会破坏应用状态）。

summary_en.core_problem: What are the specific failure modes of multi-provider LLM gateways (reverse proxies) in production, and why are they difficult to detect with traditional monitoring?
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic taxonomy (FailureAtlas) of failure modes in multi-provider LLM serving infrastructure, revealing that the most severe failures are often 'silent', offering crucial engineering guidance for building highly available LLM serving systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a two-axis taxonomy (FailureAtlas) classifying failures by 'origin layer' (Network/Transport, Streaming/Protocol, State/Session, Model Behavior, Governance/Cost) and 'detectability' (Loud vs. Silent). Populates this with five verified entries from public bug reports and first-hand stress testing, including mechanistic root-cause analyses.
summary_en.experiments: Presents five specific failure case studies, three with standalone reproduction scripts. The principal finding is that the most operationally severe failures are 'silent' (returning HTTP 200 and passing health checks while corrupting application state).

recommendation.zh: LLM Serving 基础设施的避坑指南，揭示了网关层面的“静默故障”（如 HTTP 200 但状态损坏），对负责部署和 API 封装的工程师极具参考价值。
recommendation.en: A pitfall guide for LLM Serving infrastructure, revealing 'silent failures' at the gateway level (e.g., HTTP 200 but corrupted state), highly valuable for engineers handling deployment and API wrapping.

paper.title: ContinuityBench: A Benchmark and Systems Study of Stateful Failover in Multi-Provider LLM Routing
paper.abstract: In production large language model (LLM) deployments, high API availability guarantees do not equate to conversational continuity. When a primary provider experiences an outage or strict rate-limiting, naive stateless failover mechanisms successfully maintain uptime but silently discard conversation history, severely disrupting the user experience. To rigorously quantify and resolve this failure mode, we introduce two novel metrics: Continuity Preservation Rate (CPR) and Continuity Latency Overh

summary.core_problem: 评估并缓解多 LLM provider 路由中的 failover 问题：API 可用性保持了，但对话历史在切换 provider 时丢失，导致会话连续性中断。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议和系统研究，提出面向生产 LLM 路由的连续性指标与开源压力测试 harness；它更偏 serving reliability，不直接推进预训练方法，但对部署侧评估有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个指标：Continuity Preservation Rate，衡量故障切换后上下文是否被保留；Continuity Latency Overhead，衡量转发历史带来的延迟代价。系统上实现 stateful multi-provider proxy，用 History-Forwarding 在异构 LLM endpoint 之间重建会话状态。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 750 次 failover 事件，测试高并发 provider 故障下的上下文保存情况。摘要未列出具体 provider、模型规模、延迟数值或相对 baseline 的完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and mitigates conversational state loss during failover in multi-provider LLM routing.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol and systems harness for production LLM reliability. It is about serving continuity rather than pretraining, but the failure mode is real in deployed LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Continuity Preservation Rate for measuring whether context survives failover, and Continuity Latency Overhead for measuring the latency cost of forwarding history. They implement a stateful multi-provider proxy that reconstructs conversation state across heterogeneous LLM endpoints via history forwarding.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports 750 failover events under high-concurrency provider-failure conditions. The abstract does not provide detailed model/provider choices, exact latency numbers, or full baseline deltas.

recommendation.zh: 这是部署可靠性评测，不是模型研究；只看指标定义和 failover setup，别把结论外推到训练侧。
recommendation.en: This is a deployment-reliability benchmark, not model research; read the metric definitions and failover setup, but do not extrapolate it to training.

paper.title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized

summary.core_problem: 量化 LLM 在标准评测集上表现良好，但在面对包含微小扰动（如拼写错误、语法错误）的输入时，其可靠性（不确定性估计、校准度和鲁棒性）如何变化，以及如何选择最佳量化位宽以平衡效率和可靠性。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LLM 量化中的一个重要盲区：准确率随模型总比特数单调增加，但可靠性却呈现非单调趋势。这为实际部署中选择量化策略提供了新的视角，指出单纯追求高精度或大模型并非总是最佳选择。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个包含三个维度的可靠性评估框架：预测不确定性、校准度（不确定性估计的准确性）以及对 15 种保持语义的输入扰动（字符级和词级）的鲁棒性。在 1B 到 70B 参数规模的模型上，系统评估了 6 种主流的量化方法（2、3、4、8 bit）。
summary.experiments: 发现 4-bit 量化在不同任务、模型架构和量化方法中，提供了可靠性与效率的最佳折中。中等规模的 4-bit 模型在可靠性指标上甚至优于更大规模的低比特模型或更小规模的高比特模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注图 1 中准确率与可靠性随总比特数变化的趋势对比。泛读即可，了解 4-bit 量化在可靠性上的优势结论。

summary_en.core_problem: While quantized LLMs perform well on standard benchmarks, how does their reliability (uncertainty estimation, calibration, and robustness) change when facing inputs with minor perturbations (e.g., typos, grammatical errors), and how to choose the optimal quantization bit-width to balance efficiency and reliability.
summary_en.importance: Reveals a critical blind spot in LLM quantization: accuracy increases monotonically with the total number of model bits, but reliability exhibits a non-monotonic trend. This provides a new perspective for selecting quantization strategies in practical deployment, indicating that simply pursuing high precision or large models is not always the best choice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a reliability evaluation framework comprising three dimensions: predictive uncertainty, calibration (accuracy of uncertainty estimates), and robustness to 15 types of semantically-preserving input perturbations (character-level and word-level). Systematically evaluates 6 mainstream quantization methods (2, 3, 4, 8 bits) on models ranging from 1B to 70B parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that 4-bit quantization offers the best trade-off between reliability and efficiency across different tasks, model architectures, and quantization methods. Moderately-sized 4-bit models even outperform larger low-bit models or smaller high-bit models in reliability metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the trend comparison between accuracy and reliability with respect to the total number of bits in Figure 1. Skim to understand the conclusion regarding the advantages of 4-bit quantization in reliability.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reliability-vs-bitwidth/scale 的图；它不改预训练 recipe，但会影响模型发布时的量化验收标准。
recommendation.en: Skim the reliability-versus-bitwidth/scale plots; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it can change release-time quantization acceptance tests.

paper.title: Effectiveness of LLM-based Software Diversity for Reliability Improvement -- an Empirical Study
paper.abstract: Software diversity has been extensively studied as a means of reducing the risk of common-mode failures. Classic work showed that the central issue is whether failures of diversely redundant components overlap in ways that limit the reliability gains. Traditional software diversity is costly to obtain, since it requires multiple implementations as well as the corresponding validation, maintenance, and deployment effort. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) may change this. LLMs enable

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 生成的多版本代码能否像传统软件多样性一样，通过减少共同失效来提升系统可靠性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验分析。它把经典 N-version programming 的问题迁移到 LLM 代码生成场景，核心关注点不是单个程序是否正确，而是不同生成实现的失败是否重叠。这对代码模型评测中的 pass@k、多样性采样、模型集成可靠性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是扩展经典软件多样性实验框架，用多个 LLM、不同解码设置和不同编程语言为同一规格生成候选实现，然后分析候选实现之间的故障相关性、失败重叠和冗余组合后的可靠性收益。技术上更接近 empirical SE，而不是新的代码模型训练方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验覆盖三个软件规格，比较 LLM 生成实现的多样性来源，包括模型差异、解码配置和语言差异。主要指标应围绕故障重叠、冗余投票或选择后的可靠性改善；摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据或提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM-generated code variants can provide useful software diversity and improve reliability by reducing common-mode failures.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical software engineering contribution. It imports the classic N-version programming question into LLM code generation: the key variable is not just individual correctness, but overlap among failures. It is mildly relevant to pass@k, sampling diversity, and reliability evaluation for code models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study generates multiple implementations for the same specifications using different LLMs, decoding settings, and programming languages, then measures failure correlation and reliability gains under diversified redundancy. The contribution is an empirical measurement setup rather than a new training or decoding algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions three specifications and analyzes diversity across models, decoding regimes, and programming languages. The reported focus is failure overlap and reliability improvement from redundant generated implementations; no concrete model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains are available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和失败重叠指标即可；它提醒代码模型评测别把 pass@k 当独立伯努利试验。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and failure-overlap metrics; the useful reminder is that code pass@k should not be treated as independent Bernoulli trials.

paper.title: Core dump epidemiology: fixing an 18-year-old bug
paper.abstract: OpenAI engineers used large-scale core dump analysis to debug rare infrastructure crashes, uncovering both a hardware fault and a long-standing software bug.

summary.core_problem: 大规模训练基础设施中偶发崩溃难以定位，需要从海量 core dump 中做流行病学式归因。
summary.importance: 工程实践：展示顶级实验室如何用大规模 core dump 分析同时定位硬件故障与一个存在 18 年的软件老 bug。
summary.technical_approach: 对大量 core dump 做聚类与模式挖掘，分离硬件相关与软件相关崩溃签名，进而追溯到长期潜伏的系统级 bug。
summary.experiments: 工程案例叙述，无公开量化指标。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 团队博客文章，作者为工程基础设施方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Rare crashes in large-scale training infrastructure are hard to localize, requiring epidemiological analysis across massive core dumps.
summary_en.importance: Engineering practice: demonstrates how a top lab uses large-scale core-dump analysis to simultaneously identify a hardware fault and an 18-year-old latent software bug.
summary_en.technical_approach: Clustering and pattern mining across many core dumps to separate hardware-related from software-related crash signatures, tracing back to a long-dormant system-level bug.
summary_en.experiments: Narrative engineering case; no public quantitative metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: Blog post by the OpenAI Research engineering infrastructure team.

recommendation.zh: 工程运维案例，对预训练方法无直接贡献；做大规模训练基础设施的同学可参考其 core dump 归因思路。
recommendation.en: An infrastructure-operations case with no direct pretraining-method value; useful only for engineers running large-scale training clusters as a debugging playbook reference.

paper.title: Beyond Function Calling: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents under Tool-Environment Unreliability
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that solve tasks by interacting with external tool environments. Although recent tool-use benchmarks increasingly cover complex task settings, they still largely assume clean, stable, and trustworthy tool environments, leaving tool-environment unreliability insufficiently examined. We introduce ToolBench-X, a benchmark for evaluating agents under recoverable reliability hazards. ToolBench-X contains executable multi-step tasks across dive

summary.core_problem: 现有工具调用评测大多假设工具环境稳定、接口文档可信、返回值规范。ToolBench-X 关注更接近真实系统的问题：当工具存在可恢复的不可靠性时，Agent 是否还能完成多步任务，而不只是生成正确的函数名和参数。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把工具使用失败拆成可控的环境不可靠性，而不是只看 function calling accuracy。这有助于区分模型的调用能力、错误诊断能力、证据校验能力和恢复策略能力。对后训练和推理时扩展也有启发：很多失败不是任务不可解，而是模型没有正确识别异常、没有复核中间证据，或过早给出答案。
summary.technical_approach: ToolBench-X 构造了 1106 个可执行多步任务和 4956 个 Python 工具，覆盖顺序、并行、混合三类工作流。每个任务有确定性工具和标准最终答案，支持自动执行和 exact-match 评测。核心设计是从干净工具环境出发，系统注入五类 reliability hazards：Specification Drift、Invocation Error、Execution Failure、Output Drift、Cross-Source Conflict。注入的错误必须是 disruptive 但 recoverable，即会干扰模型，但任务仍保留至少一条可行恢复路径，例如重试、fallback、交叉验证、输出归一化、证据补全。这个设计区别于简单的工具破坏或噪声注入，因为它评估的是恢复能力，而不是把任务变成不可解。
summary.experiments: 基准规模为 1106 tasks / 4956 tools。与 BFCL、ToolBench、τ-bench、T-EVAL、UltraTool、AgentNoiseBench 等相比，ToolBench-X 同时覆盖五类工具环境不可靠性，并包含顺序、并行、混合工具流。实验结论是当前被测模型在可靠性 hazard 下整体脆弱，所有模型成功率均低于 60%。作者还测试了 targeted hints 和 failure-triggered test-time scaling：当模型遇到困难时提供针对性提示，或允许模型基于失败反馈进行额外反思和多轮推理，任务完成率会明显提升。这说明一部分失败可以通过更好的诊断和推理预算缓解。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对工具环境不可靠性的定义，Table 1 中与已有工具评测的差异，以及 benchmark construction / hazard taxonomy 部分。实验部分主要看不同 hazard 下的失败模式、hint 的增益、failure-triggered test-time scaling 的设置。对预训练研究者更有价值的是错误类型设计和自动评测协议，而不是具体排行榜数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Most tool-use benchmarks assume clean APIs, stable documentation, and trustworthy outputs. ToolBench-X evaluates a harder and more realistic setting: whether an agent can finish multi-step tasks when the tool environment contains recoverable reliability hazards, not merely whether it can emit the right function call.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to pretraining, but it is useful for evaluating agent robustness. It separates function-call correctness from failure diagnosis, evidence verification, and recovery behavior. This distinction matters for post-training and inference-time scaling: many failures are not caused by unsolvable tasks, but by the model trusting suspicious observations, failing to cross-check evidence, or stopping before the required information is complete.
summary_en.technical_approach: ToolBench-X contains 1,106 executable multi-step tasks and 4,956 Python tools, covering sequential, parallel, and mixed workflows. Each task has deterministic tools and a canonical final answer, enabling automatic execution and exact-match evaluation. Starting from clean environments, the benchmark injects five structured hazard types: specification drift, invocation errors, execution failures, output drift, and cross-source conflicts. A key design constraint is recoverability. The injected hazards should disrupt the agent, but every task should still preserve at least one viable recovery path, such as retrying, falling back to another tool, normalizing outputs, cross-checking sources, or verifying incomplete evidence. This makes the benchmark different from simple API corruption or random noise injection.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark scale is 1,106 tasks and 4,956 tools. Compared with BFCL, ToolBench, τ-bench, T-EVAL, UltraTool, and AgentNoiseBench, ToolBench-X jointly covers five forms of tool-environment unreliability and supports sequential, parallel, and mixed tool-use workflows. The evaluated models remain fragile under these hazards, with all reported success rates below 60%. Targeted hints substantially improve task completion when the model gets stuck. Failure-triggered test-time scaling, where the model reflects on failed attempts and spends additional reasoning rounds, also improves performance. These results suggest that better diagnosis and recovery policies can recover a nontrivial fraction of failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the motivation in the introduction, Table 1 for the benchmark comparison, and the sections defining the hazard taxonomy and benchmark construction. In the experiments, look at per-hazard failure patterns, the effect of targeted hints, and the failure-triggered test-time scaling setup. For pretraining researchers, the main value is the taxonomy and evaluation protocol rather than the absolute leaderboard numbers.

recommendation.zh: Agent 评测里这个 setup 比普通 function-calling 更干净；看 hazard taxonomy 和 recovery-path 标注即可。
recommendation.en: This setup is cleaner than ordinary function-calling benchmarks; read the hazard taxonomy and recovery-path construction.

paper.title: Same Evidence, Different Answer: Auditing Order Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Standard benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) score each item on one canonical ordering and miss whether order-irrelevant shuffling changes the answer, a baseline reliability property called for by emerging AI evaluation guidelines. We introduce Facet-Probe, a five-facet audit (option, evidence-chunk, document-rank, image-set, and mixed-modality ordering) of 18 frontier and open-weight MLLMs. A Bayesian item-response model separates ordering noise from per-facet bias, and a sa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究多模态大模型对输入顺序的敏感性：在证据内容不变、仅做语义上应当等价的重排时，模型是否会给出不同答案。作者指出，现有 benchmark 通常只在一个 canonical ordering 上打分，因此默认了“顺序无关”这个假设，却很少真正检验。论文要解决的核心问题不是再做一个多模态能力榜单，而是审计一种更基础的可靠性属性：同样的证据，换个排列，答案是否稳定。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义主要在评测与训练信号两端。评测端，这篇文章提醒人们，单次 canonical benchmark accuracy 可能系统性高估模型在 multimodal RAG、检索增强、agent 调度、临床界面等场景中的可靠性。训练端，它暴露出模型并没有学到真正稳健的证据聚合规则，而是部分依赖位置偏置、排序启发式或后验合理化。对于做 native multimodal pretrain、长上下文融合、跨模态对齐的人，这类顺序敏感性不是小毛病，而是表示学习和解码策略共同留下的偏差。论文的贡献主要是构建了一个较完整的审计框架，而不是提出新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两个核心部件：Facet-Probe 审计框架，以及 ODI（Ordering-Decomposed Item-Response Theory）分解模型。

Facet-Probe 把“顺序”拆成五个 facet 来测：选项顺序、证据块顺序、文档排名顺序、图像集合顺序、以及混合模态顺序。这个设计比只测 option-order 更完整，因为多模态系统里的顺序来源很多：检索器返回的文档顺序、图像拼接顺序、文本与图像交错顺序，都可能影响答案。作者在 12 个数据集、4 类任务上对 18 个 MLLM 做了大规模试验，试图覆盖从 MCQ reasoning 到多证据聚合的不同场景。

ODI 的作用是把 observed flip rate 拆开。作者认为，模型在不同顺序下答案变化，既可能来自真正的 ordering bias，也可能只是解码随机性或边界不稳定。为此他们引入一个 2PL Bayesian IRT 风格的分解，把每个 item 的 ordering noise 与每个 facet 的系统性偏置分开估计。这里一个关键设计是 same-ordering control：对完全相同输入重复解码，用它估计 decoder stochastic floor，再看真正换顺序后多出来多少 flip。这个控制很重要，否则“顺序敏感”里会混入大量普通采样噪声。

作者还做了机制分析和 mitigation 测试。机制上，文中提到一个常见失败模式是 content rationalization：模型先被顺序牵引到某个答案，再事后围绕当前顺序中的显著证据编造看似合理的解释。缓解上，他们测试了 training-free prompt 改写，但发现这些方法是 modality-conditional 的，在文本任务上有效的提示，不一定能迁移到视觉推理或混合模态场景，也很难叠加组合。
summary.experiments:
实验规模比较大：18 个模型，包含 6 个闭源前沿模型和 12 个开源模型；12 个数据集；总试验数超过 40 万。模型覆盖 Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT，以及 Qwen3.5-VL、InternVL3.5、Kimi-VL、MedGemma 等家族。闭源模型尽量用温度 0 或接近的确定性设置，开源模型用 greedy decoding，以减少把解码噪声误判为顺序效应。

核心结果有几条。第一，没有任何一个被测 MLLM 真正顺序不变。筛选后的各 facet 平均 flip rate 在 24% 到 50% 之间；即便是表现最好的模型，仍有 13.4% 的 trial 会因顺序变化而翻转答案。第二，能力强的模型通常更稳，文中给出 capability 与 flip rate 的 Spearman 相关约为 -0.95，但能力提升并不能消除这个问题，只能降低其频率。第三，模型自报置信度明显低估顺序风险，低估幅度达到 9 到 62 个百分点，说明 calibration 并不能替代顺序鲁棒性审计。第四，在 Gemini 的 same-ordering control 中，即使温度设为 0，真实换序带来的 flip 仍显著高于同输入重复解码的噪声底线，支持“顺序效应是真实存在的系统偏差”这一结论。第五，prompt-level mitigation 有一定效果，但高度依赖模态和任务，不具备统一迁移性。

如果从全文里抓重点，建议特别关注各 facet 的差异，而不是只看总体 flip rate。因为 option-order、document-rank、image-set ordering 背后的机制并不一样，对训练改进的指向也不同。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合当评测方法论文来读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，明确作者不是在讨论一般 prompt sensitivity，而是在讨论语义等价重排下的 order invariance。然后直接看 Facet-Probe 的五个 facet 定义，理解每一种顺序扰动对应什么真实系统场景。

接着看 ODI 和 same-ordering control。这里是全文最值得细读的部分，因为它决定了结果是否可信。重点看作者如何区分 ordering noise、systematic bias 和 decoder stochastic floor；如果只看 flip rate 而不看这个分解，很容易高估或误解问题。

实验部分建议先看总表，再看 capability vs. flip 的相关图、same-ordering control 图，以及 mechanism analysis。若你关心训练改进，可以重点看 mitigation 小节，但不要期待现成 recipe；作者的结论更像是“简单 prompt 修补不够，问题更深”。

泛读大约 30–40 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你做多模态检索、长上下文融合或 benchmark 设计，建议把附录里的 prompt 适配、数据筛选和 exploratory claim 的限定条件也一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits order sensitivity in multimodal LLMs: when the evidence is unchanged but presented in semantically equivalent permutations, does the answer remain stable? The central problem is not to build another capability leaderboard, but to test a basic reliability property that current benchmarks usually assume rather than verify. Standard multimodal evaluations score one canonical ordering and implicitly treat all equivalent permutations as interchangeable. This work asks whether that assumption actually holds.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is on the evaluation side, with implications for training. For evaluation, it shows that canonical benchmark accuracy can systematically overstate reliability in multimodal RAG, retrieval pipelines, agent tool scheduling, and high-stakes interfaces where users expect the same evidence to yield the same answer. For training and representation learning, the findings suggest that many MLLMs have not learned robust evidence aggregation rules; instead, they still rely partly on positional bias, ranking heuristics, or post-hoc rationalization. For researchers working on native multimodal pretraining, long-context fusion, or cross-modal alignment, this is not a cosmetic issue. It points to a mismatch between nominal task competence and invariance properties that a well-behaved model should satisfy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components: Facet-Probe and ODI.

Facet-Probe is a five-facet audit of ordering effects: option order, evidence-chunk order, document-rank order, image-set order, and mixed-modality order. This is a stronger design than prior work that only studies one ordering axis, because real multimodal systems inherit ordering from many sources: retrieval rank, chunk packing, image arrangement, and interleaving of text and visual evidence. The benchmark spans 12 datasets and four task families, aiming to cover both standard multiple-choice reasoning and multi-evidence aggregation settings.

ODI, or Ordering-Decomposed Item-Response Theory, is the statistical layer that separates different sources of answer flips. The authors argue that observed answer changes across permutations can come from true ordering bias, but also from decoder stochasticity or fragile decision boundaries. To disentangle these, they use a Bayesian 2PL IRT-style decomposition that estimates per-item ordering noise and per-facet systematic bias. A key design choice is the same-ordering control: the exact same input is decoded multiple times to estimate the stochastic floor, and only the excess flip rate under actual reordering is attributed to ordering effects. This control is essential; without it, raw flip rates are hard to interpret.

The paper also includes mechanism analysis and mitigation tests. One recurring mechanism is content rationalization: the model is nudged toward an answer by the ordering, then generates a plausible explanation around whichever evidence appears salient in that arrangement. For mitigation, the authors test training-free prompt modifications, but find that these are modality-conditional. A prompt trick that helps text-heavy settings does not necessarily transfer to visual reasoning or mixed-modality tasks, and different mitigations do not compose cleanly.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical study is large: 18 models, including 6 frontier closed-source systems and 12 open-weight models; 12 datasets; and more than 400,000 trials. The model set includes Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT variants, along with Qwen3.5-VL, InternVL3.5, Kimi-VL, and MedGemma families. Closed models are queried with temperature 0 where possible, and open models are greedily decoded, specifically to reduce the chance of mistaking ordinary decoding randomness for ordering effects.

Several findings stand out. First, none of the audited MLLMs is order-invariant. Screened panel-mean flip rates across facets range from 24% to 50%, and even the best model still flips on 13.4% of trials. Second, stronger models are generally more stable, with a reported Spearman correlation of about -0.95 between capability and flip rate, but capability does not eliminate the issue. Third, self-reported confidence substantially underestimates ordering risk, by 9 to 62 percentage points, so calibration alone is not a sufficient reliability signal. Fourth, the same-ordering control on Gemini shows that even at temperature 0, the excess flips under reordered inputs remain well above the same-input stochastic floor, supporting the claim that the effect is a real systematic bias rather than just decoder noise. Fifth, prompt-level mitigations can help, but only in a modality- and task-specific way.

When reading the results, it is more useful to compare the five facets than to focus only on the overall flip rate, because option-order, document-rank, and image-set sensitivity likely arise from different mechanisms and imply different remedies.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as an evaluation-method paper rather than a modeling paper. Start with the introduction and the high-level setup to understand that the target is order invariance under semantically equivalent permutations, not generic prompt sensitivity.

Then go straight to the definition of the five Facet-Probe axes. Each facet corresponds to a realistic source of ordering in deployed systems, and understanding those mappings helps interpret the results.

Next, read the ODI section carefully. This is the most important technical part because it determines whether the reported instability is actually attributable to ordering. Focus on how the paper separates ordering noise, systematic bias, and the decoder stochastic floor. Raw flip rates without this decomposition would be much less convincing.

In the experiments, first scan the main summary tables, then read the capability-versus-flip correlation plots, the same-ordering control results, and the mechanism analysis. If you care about practical fixes, read the mitigation section, but the main lesson is not a ready-made recipe; it is that shallow prompt repairs do not solve the deeper invariance problem.

A 30–40 minute pass should be enough for the main ideas. If you work on multimodal retrieval, long-context fusion, or benchmark design, the appendix details on prompt adapters, dataset screening, and exploratory claims are also worth reading.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但它把“顺序扰动”从评测噪声变成了可测失效模式；做多模态 pretrain 的人至少该看方法和主表，别再默认 shuffle 无害。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it turns order sensitivity from vague eval noise into a measurable failure mode; if you train MLLMs, read the method and main table before assuming shuffling is harmless.

paper.title: On the Reliability of Networks of AI Agents: Density Evolution, Stopping Sets, and Architecture Optimization
paper.abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly solve a task not with a single model call but with several imperfect agents working together: some propose pieces of a solution, others verify them, and the results are combined. These systems often outperform any single model, yet it is rarely clear why they succeed or when they will fail. We model such a system as message passing on a sparse graph, the structure that underlies low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, and extend the density-evolution machinery of co

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图回答：由多个不完美 AI agent 组成的协作网络，为什么有时比单次模型调用更可靠，以及它会在什么结构条件下系统性失效。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在分析框架而不在模型能力本身。它把多 agent 系统抽象成稀疏因子图，并借用编码理论里的 density evolution 和 stopping sets 来刻画误差传播与失败模式，属于方法论上的机制分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把任务表示为一组耦合的二值子命题，把 agent 架构表示为带角色类型的稀疏 factor graph。proposal agent、verifier 和通信边都可能产生 erasure，消息以集合值形式在图上传播；随后将 LDPC 码分析中的 density evolution 扩展到含噪布尔校验节点的 setting，用来预测迭代推理的收敛与失败，并讨论架构优化。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验重点应是理论预测与仿真的一致性，以及不同图结构、校验函数和 erasure 机制下的可靠性边界，而不是大规模 LLM 训练或标准 agent benchmark 刷分。没有看到与主流 LLM agent 系统的大规模实证对比、模型参数量或预训练数据规模等信息，因此对基座预训练的直接证据较弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why networks of imperfect AI agents can be more reliable than a single model call, and under what structural conditions they fail systematically.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly analytical rather than capability-driven. It recasts multi-agent systems as sparse factor graphs and imports density evolution and stopping-set ideas from coding theory to characterize error propagation and failure modes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tasks are modeled as coupled binary subclaims, and an agent architecture is represented as a role-typed sparse factor graph. Proposal agents, verifiers, and communication edges can all induce erasures, while set-valued messages are passed over the graph. The paper extends LDPC-style density evolution to noisy Boolean verifier nodes and uses it to study convergence, failure, and architecture optimization.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the experiments are likely centered on agreement between theory and simulation, plus reliability boundaries under different graph structures, verifier functions, and erasure mechanisms, rather than large-scale LLM training or mainstream agent benchmarks. There is no clear evidence of large empirical studies on modern LLM agent stacks, model scales, or pretraining regimes, so the direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把多 agent 可靠性写成可分析的图模型这点有意思；只需看建模假设和 failure mode，别把结论外推到真实 LLM 系统。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the graph-theoretic treatment of multi-agent reliability is worth a glance; read the assumptions and failure modes, but do not overgeneralize to real LLM systems.

paper.title: Multiagent Protocols with Aggregated Confidence Signals
paper.abstract: Confidence is used for reliability, oversight, and a range of downstream decision tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP), yet no existing method produces or evaluates a confidence for the output of a multiagent system. Prior work uses confidence within multiagent debate (MAD) to weight messages, trigger debate, or calibrate individual agents, but it never aggregates these into a single confidence for the system itself. We introduce three protocols that produce a final answer along with a sin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：多智能体系统给出最终答案时，如何把各个 agent 的置信信号聚合成一个可比较、可校准、可用于决策的系统级置信度。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 agent 可靠性方法，而不是基座模型训练。它的价值在于把单 agent 置信度扩展到 multi-agent setting，并给出可验证的聚合协议与校准流程；对做 post-train、judge、self-verification 或多 agent 推理系统的人有参考意义，但对预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三种协议：先把不同模型产生的原始 confidence 做变换，使其在跨模型间可比；再用 soft voting 或一种称为 Bayesian fusion 的概率融合方式，得到单一系统级 confidence。文中还比较了两类置信估计器，包括 sequence probability 和 self-report confidence，并分析它们在多 agent 聚合中的表现差异。
summary.experiments: 实验以 AUARC 评估置信度判别力，以 F1 评估答案正确性。结果显示，聚合后的 confidence 比最佳单 agent 或标准 multi-agent debate baseline 更有区分度，同时 F1 基本保持稳定，并在更模糊的任务上弥补了 MAD 带来的性能损失。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体任务集细节，因此目前更像一篇系统协议层面的经验论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to produce a single, calibrated system-level confidence score for a multi-agent system, rather than leaving confidence at the individual-agent level.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent reliability paper, not a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its value is in extending confidence estimation from single-agent outputs to multi-agent protocols with explicit aggregation and calibration; useful for people working on post-training, judges, self-verification, or multi-agent reasoning systems, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose three protocols: first transform raw confidence signals so they become comparable across models, then aggregate them via soft voting or a probability-fusion method they call Bayesian fusion. They also compare two confidence estimators, including sequence probability and self-reported confidence, and analyze how they behave under multi-agent aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate discriminative quality with AUARC and answer quality with F1. Aggregated confidence is reported to be more discriminative than the best single agent and standard debate baselines, while keeping F1 roughly stable and recovering some losses that MAD incurs on ambiguous tasks. The abstract does not provide model scales, dataset sizes, or detailed task setup, so this currently reads as a protocol-level empirical paper.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深；若你在做 verifier、self-eval 或多 agent 置信校准，只看聚合协议与 AUARC 结果，别把它误当成能力提升论文。
recommendation.en: Not very pretrain-relevant; read only the aggregation protocol and AUARC tables if you care about verifier-style confidence calibration, not capability gains.

paper.title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice ques

summary.core_problem: MLLM在视频理解中对缺失正确答案的识别能力尚未被系统诊断。
summary.importance: 首次系统诊断MLLM在视频理解中的缺失答案检测行为，含三种评测设置。
summary.technical_approach: 三种设置：多选加NOTA选项、开放式生成加检测指令、无引导标准评测；探索CoT作为缓解策略。
summary.experiments: MLLM压倒性选择看似合理的干扰项而非检测缺失答案；时间推理任务失败更明显；稠密帧采样恶化问题。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM ability to detect when no correct answer exists in video understanding is undiagnosed.
summary_en.importance: First systematic diagnostic of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding across three evaluation settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three settings: multiple-choice with NOTA, open-ended generation with detection instruction, standard evaluation without guidance; explore CoT as mitigation.
summary_en.experiments: MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors; failure worse in temporal reasoning; denser frame sampling worsens problem.

recommendation.zh: 对MLLM视频理解可靠性的诊断性研究，发现稠密帧采样反而恶化缺失答案检测，作为领域内备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Diagnostic study of MLLM reliability in video QA; denser frame sampling worsens absent-answer detection. Literature reference only, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Calibration vs Decision Making: Revisiting the Reliability Paradox in Unlearned Language Models
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a model while preserving reliable behavior on the remaining data, making reliable prediction and uncertainty estimation essential for evaluation. Calibration is commonly used as a proxy for reliability in language models, but low calibration error does not necessarily imply reliable decision rules, as models may rely on spurious correlations while remaining well calibrated. We investigate this gap in generative langua

summary.core_problem: 在 machine unlearning 的语言模型评估中，低 calibration error 是否真的代表模型决策可靠，这一点并不成立且缺少系统检验。
summary.importance: 这是可靠性分析工作。贡献在于指出 calibration 与 decision-rule reliability 之间存在裂缝，尤其在 unlearning 场景下，常用概率校准指标可能掩盖模型仍依赖 shortcut 的事实。对做后训练、遗忘、reward 设计的人有提醒意义，但离预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 在 TOFU benchmark 的多选问答协议上，同时测量概率层面的 calibration 指标（ECE、MCE、Brier）和决策规则层面的可靠性，后者通过 Integrated Gradients 与 Local Mutual Information 做 attribution-based shortcut detection。核心是把“置信度是否匹配正确率”和“模型是否依赖错误证据”分开看。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出一个关键结果：fine-tuned 模型的 ECE 约 0.04，明显低于 pretrained 模型的 ECE > 0.5；而 unlearning 后模型仍保持类似的低 calibration，但决策准确性与依据质量下降。这说明 calibration 改善并不等于决策更可靠。实验集中在 TOFU 和 MCQA 协议，外推性有限。
summary.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur)。作者背景未显示与大规模基座模型训练有直接代表性关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether low calibration error really implies reliable decisions in language-model unlearning, and argues that it does not.
summary_en.importance: This is a reliability-analysis paper. Its contribution is to expose a gap between calibration and decision-rule reliability, especially in unlearning settings where standard confidence metrics may hide shortcut dependence. It is more relevant to post-training and forgetting than to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the TOFU benchmark with a multiple-choice QA protocol, the paper jointly measures probabilistic calibration (ECE, MCE, Brier) and decision-rule reliability via attribution-based shortcut detection using Integrated Gradients and Local Mutual Information. The key move is to separate confidence-quality alignment from evidence-quality alignment.
summary_en.experiments: A notable result in the abstract is that fine-tuned models achieve ECE around 0.04 versus pretrained models with ECE above 0.5, while unlearned models retain similarly low calibration despite degraded accuracy and poorer evidence use. This suggests better calibration does not imply better decision reliability. The setup is centered on TOFU and MCQA, so external validity is limited.
summary_en.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur). No clear indication of authors being known for large-scale foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但把“校准好≠决策可靠”在 unlearning 上讲得更具体；若你做对齐/遗忘评测可看指标设计，否则只记住这个坑即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new thesis, but it makes the 'well-calibrated does not mean reliable decisions' point concrete for unlearning; useful for alignment/forgetting eval, skippable otherwise.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur)

paper.title: Measuring Five-Nines Reliability: Sample-Efficient LLM Evaluation in Saturated Benchmarks
paper.abstract: While existing benchmarks demonstrate the near-perfect performance of large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, this apparent saturation often obscures the need for rigorous evaluation of their reliability. In real-world deployment, however, achieving extremely high reliability (e.g., "five-nines" (99.999%) vs. "three-nines" (99.9%)) is fundamentally critical, as this gap results in an order-of-magnitude increase in failures, which is catastrophic in reliability-critical applications. Still

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM基准下模型性能看似饱和，无法高效估计极低失败概率（如五个九可靠性），标准蒙特卡洛评估所需推理量过大的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次利用LLM失败存在系统性模式的观测，提出样本高效的高可靠性LLM评估方法。
summary.technical_approach: 学习集中在高失败概率输入的采样分布，替代随机采样，大幅降低稀有失败概率估计所需的样本量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验结果，理论上可以在有限计算预算下实现高置信度的极低失败概率估计。
summary.authors_note: 来自卡内基梅隆大学，J. Zico Kolter为深度学习理论与系统领域知名研究员。

summary_en.core_problem: Solves the problem that LLM performance appears saturated on existing benchmarks, making it hard to estimate extremely low failure probability (e.g. five-nines reliability), standard Monte Carlo evaluation requires prohibitive inference cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first leverages the observation that LLM failures have strong systematic patterns to propose sample-efficient high-reliability LLM evaluation method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Learns a sampling distribution concentrated on high-failure-probability inputs to replace random sampling, drastically reduces sample size required for rare failure probability estimation.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results are not disclosed in abstract, theoretically achieves high-confidence extremely low failure probability estimation under limited compute budget.
summary_en.authors_note: From Carnegie Mellon University, J. Zico Kolter is a well-known researcher in deep learning theory and systems.

recommendation.zh: 重点看高失败样本的采样策略设计部分，对预训练后高可靠性模型的评测方法有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: Focus on high-failure-sample sampling strategy design, directly valuable for evaluation methods of high-reliability LLM after pretraining.

paper.title: Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?
paper.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated impressive retrieval-augmented capabilities. However, a crucial area remains underexplored: their ability to appropriately adapt responses to the certainty of the retrieved information. It is a limitation with real consequences in high-stakes domains like medicine and finance. We evaluate eight LLMs on their context-certainty obedience, measuring how well they adjust responses to match expressed context certainty. Our analysis reveals systematic limitation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 LLM 在 RAG 场景中是否能按检索信息的外部置信度调整回答，而不是看到上下文后就过度相信它。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但对训练目标和评测设计有启发。当前 LLM 往往会把上下文当成强证据，即使上下文被明确标注为低置信度。这个现象说明，模型在预训练和指令训练中学到的是“利用上下文”，但不一定学到“按概率权重使用上下文”。对后续的 pretrain/posttrain 数据设计来说，这提示需要显式训练模型处理外部校准概率、冲突知识和低置信检索证据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 context-certainty obedience，用一个概率混合目标定义理想行为。给定问题、检索上下文和置信度 c，理想输出分布应当介于两端：c=0 时回到模型无上下文的 prior response，c=1 时严格遵循上下文；中间置信度则按 c 在 prior distribution 和 context-conditioned distribution 之间插值。这个定义把问题从“答案是否正确”转成“模型是否服从外部置信度”。论文进一步分析三类失败：模型看到上下文后很难恢复原先的 prior；会误读概率表达；面对长而复杂的上下文时，即使置信度低也更容易过信。修复方案不改模型参数，而是一个交互策略：先提醒模型无上下文时的回答，再把置信度表达重标定成模型更容易理解的形式，最后简化上下文。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ClashEval 上评估 8 个 LLM，覆盖 Llama、Qwen、Gemma 的不同尺寸版本。主要指标是 context-certainty obedience error。原始提示下，模型平均错误为 0.52；加入三步交互策略后降到 0.39，约 25% 相对下降。定性和分解分析显示，低置信上下文尤其困难，因为模型会被已经看到的上下文锚定；复杂上下文会放大这种锚定；概率数字本身也不能保证模型按线性权重理解不确定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 evaluation framework，尤其是如何用 prior distribution 与 context-based distribution 的线性混合定义理想输出。然后看 error 分解和三步交互策略的消融。若关注预训练，可重点思考两点：第一，训练语料中是否缺少带显式置信度的冲突上下文；第二，SFT/RL 是否把“引用上下文”过度奖励成了默认行为。具体 RAG 应用场景可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can use retrieved evidence according to an externally supplied certainty score, instead of treating any provided context as authoritative.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and prompting paper rather than a pretraining method paper, but it exposes a training-relevant weakness. Modern LLMs are trained and post-trained to exploit context, yet they are not reliably trained to weight context by calibrated probabilities. For pretraining and post-training research, the result points to a missing capability: models need to learn how to condition on explicit uncertainty, resolve conflicts between parametric knowledge and retrieved evidence, and ignore low-certainty context when appropriate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize context-certainty obedience through a probabilistic mixture target. Given a retrieved context with certainty c, the ideal model behavior should interpolate between two distributions: the prior answer distribution without context and the context-following distribution. At c=0, the model should ignore the context; at c=1, it should follow it. This avoids evaluating only answer accuracy and instead measures whether the model obeys the external certainty signal. The paper identifies three failure modes: poor recall of the pre-context prior after seeing uncertain evidence, distorted interpretation of probability expressions, and overtrust in long or complex contexts. The proposed intervention is parameter-free: remind the model of its prior response, recalibrate the certainty wording, and simplify the retrieved context.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses ClashEval and eight LLMs from families including Llama, Qwen, and Gemma, with different model sizes. The proposed interaction strategy reduces the average context-certainty obedience error from 0.52 to 0.39, a 25% relative reduction. The analysis shows that low-certainty contexts are particularly hard because the model remains anchored to the observed evidence. Long and complex passages increase overtrust, and numeric certainty statements are not interpreted as clean linear probabilities by default.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the evaluation framework carefully, especially the definition of the ideal mixture between prior and context-conditioned behavior. Then inspect the failure-mode analysis and the ablation of the three interaction steps. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful question is how to create training mixtures with explicit certainty annotations, conflicting retrieved evidence, and rewards that do not always favor context adherence. Domain-specific RAG examples can be skimmed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是训法论文，但把 RAG 失败拆成“确定性服从错误”很干净；只看评测定义和 25% 降错的交互干预就够，适合反推 post-train 数据设计。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but the decomposition of RAG failure into certainty-obedience errors is clean; read the evaluation setup and the 25% error reduction intervention, then map it back to post-training data design.

paper.title: Counting as a minimal probe of language model reliability
paper.abstract: Large language models perform strongly on benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, coding and document analysis, suggesting a broad ability to follow instructions. However, it remains unclear whether such success reflects general logical competence, repeated application of learned procedures, or pattern matching that mimics rule execution. We investigate this question by introducing Stable Counting Capacity, an assay in which models count repeated symbols until failure. The assay removes knowledge

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要回答一个很窄但重要的问题：LLM 在没有知识、语义线索、格式约束和任务模板帮助时，能把一个简单规则稳定执行多久。作者选择“数一串完全相同的符号并输出数量”作为最小探针，用 Stable Counting Capacity, SCC，测量模型在状态跟踪失效前能处理的最大长度。核心不是证明模型不会数数，而是用计数作为可控实验，定位模型执行程序性规则的可靠边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在评测信号，而不是新模型结构。SCC 把“长上下文能力”和“跨长序列维护规则定义状态的能力”分开了。许多长上下文模型可以读入很长 prompt，但在远低于上下文窗口的位置失去稳定计数能力，这说明 context length benchmark 不能直接代表状态维护能力。这个结果对基座训练有直接启发：只靠 next-token 预测和自然语料中的隐式程序模式，模型可能学到有限范围内的 procedure mimicry，但未必获得开放长度上的算法泛化。它也提醒预训练评测需要加入无限可采样、无知识依赖、可定位失败边界的 mechanical assays，而不能只依赖知识型 benchmark 的平均准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计刻意去掉常见混杂因素。输入是一段同质 item 序列，模型只需输出一个整数。评测数的是 item，不是 tokenizer 切出来的 token，因此避免把 tokenizer 粒度误当作模型能力。主评测不使用 JSON 或复杂 schema，减少 parser 和格式跟随能力对结果的影响。作者用 adaptive randomized ladder scheme 逐步增加序列长度，并在接近失败边界时重复采样，定义模型稳定失败前的长度为 Counting Capacity, CC。这个设计和固定题集不同：样本可以无限生成，规则极简单，正确答案精确，训练集泄漏和世界知识影响都被压到很低。与 ARC-AGI 这类机械 benchmark 相比，SCC 更像一个单变量压力测试，牺牲任务多样性，换取对状态维护边界的清晰测量。
summary.experiments: 关键观察是模型不是逐渐产生小误差，而是在 CC 附近从稳定区突然进入结构性失败区。以 claude-sonnet-4-6 的一次代表性运行看，稳定区内输出几乎沿着真实长度的对角线前进；越过边界后，模型常跳到 500、1000、2000 等显著整数，而不是给出接近真实值的局部偏差。作者把不同模型的预测按各自 CC 归一化后叠加，稳定区仍集中在对角线附近，边界后误差大且不可预测。错误输出还会聚集在有限的一组偏好整数上，尤其是 10 或 100 的倍数。这更像有限内部状态在边界处崩溃，而不是连续近似器的平滑误差增长。实验还显示所有被测 LLM 都有可测的 CC，新模型往往更高，但长上下文系统的 CC 通常远小于标称 context window。这个差异是最有信息量的实验结果：能接受长输入，不等于能在长输入上稳定维护一个由规则定义的变量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中 mechanical benchmark 和 knowledge-based benchmark 的区分，以及 SCC 为什么要避免 tokenizer、JSON schema 和语义 landmark。随后重点看 Fig. 1 的 CC 分布和长上下文对比，它给出这项评测的主结论。Fig. 2 更值得细读：稳定区、突然塌缩、归一化后跨模型形态一致、错误集中到偏好整数，这些现象支撑“有限状态式 procedure mimicry”的解释。Supplementary Note 3 的 adaptive randomized ladder scheme 也需要看，那里决定 CC 是否是稳健指标，而不是某个长度上的偶然失败。若从预训练角度深挖，重点不是计数任务本身，而是它如何暴露 next-token LM 在长期状态维护、算法外推、隐式 scratchpad 缺失上的限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks a narrow but diagnostic question: how long can a language model execute a simple rule when knowledge, semantics, formatting cues, and external memory aids are removed. It uses homogeneous sequence counting as a minimal probe and defines Stable Counting Capacity, SCC, as the point where the model can no longer reliably return the exact number of repeated items. The target is not counting as a user task. Counting is used as a controlled assay for procedural state maintenance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation instrument for foundation-model research. SCC separates long-context ingestion from reliable state tracking over a long input. A model may accept a long context while failing to carry a single rule-defined variable far below its advertised window. This matters for pretraining because standard next-token training on natural data may teach bounded procedure imitation without yielding length-general algorithmic behavior. The result also argues for mechanical assays that are infinitely sampleable, knowledge-free, exact, and able to expose a failure boundary, rather than relying only on average accuracy over knowledge-heavy benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The assay is deliberately stripped down. The model receives a sequence of identical items and must output one integer. The measured unit is the item, not the tokenizer token, which reduces tokenizer-specific confounds. The main setup avoids JSON and other output schemas, so parsing and format following are not part of the measurement. Sequence length is increased with an adaptive randomized ladder scheme, with repeated trials near the failure region, and the resulting boundary is reported as Counting Capacity. Compared with fixed mechanical benchmarks such as ARC-style tests, SCC is less broad but more controlled: the rule is elementary, instances can be generated without limit, and the measured variable is a clear procedural boundary.
summary_en.experiments: The central empirical pattern is abrupt failure rather than gradual degradation. In a representative run for claude-sonnet-4-6, predictions follow the diagonal in the stable region and then break near the CC boundary. After failure, outputs often jump to salient values such as 500, 1000, or 2000 instead of small local errors around the true count. When predictions from different models are normalized by each model’s CC and overlaid, the same structure appears: tight diagonal behavior before the boundary, followed by large and unpredictable errors after it. Incorrect outputs cluster around a restricted set of preferred integers, especially multiples of 10 or 100. This pattern is more consistent with the collapse of a finite internal state than with a smooth continuous approximation. The evaluated models all have measurable counting capacities. Newer models often support larger capacities, but long-context models still lose stable counting far below their nominal context windows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction for the distinction between knowledge-based benchmarks and mechanical assays, and for the design choices that remove tokenizer, schema, and semantic confounds. Fig. 1 is the main entry point for the capacity distribution and the long-context comparison. Fig. 2 is the key mechanistic evidence: stable diagonal behavior, sudden collapse, cross-model normalization, and preferred erroneous integers. Supplementary Note 3 is important because the adaptive ladder procedure determines whether CC is a stable boundary rather than a noisy single-point measurement. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is not whether models can count, but what SCC reveals about next-token models, long-range state maintenance, and length extrapolation of learned procedures.

recommendation.zh: 应读：它把“长上下文=长程可靠计算”这个 prior 切开了，复现成本低，适合放进内部 eval。
recommendation.en: Read it: it separates long context from reliable long-horizon computation, and the assay is cheap enough to add to internal evals.

paper.title: What Single-Prompt Accuracy Misses: A Multi-Variant Reliability Audit of Language Models
paper.abstract: Single-prompt accuracy is the dominant way to benchmark language models, but it can miss reliability failures that matter. We evaluate a 15-model open-weight corpus, with the main reliability analyses focused on 10 instruct models across five classification and reasoning benchmarks under five prompt variants each, measuring accuracy, token-probability calibration, verbal-confidence calibration, verbal parse rate, and prompt-perturbation spread for every (model x dataset x variant) cell. We find

summary.core_problem: 单一 prompt 的准确率会掩盖小模型在校准、可解析性和 prompt 扰动稳定性上的可靠性问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于评测方法。1–8B 小模型常用于本地部署、agent 子模块和低成本推理，单一准确率不足以描述它们的行为边界。该工作显示，评测 pipeline 的选择会显著改变结论，例如校准概率是否做 label-set normalization、CoT 输出是否仍用 first-character evaluator 解析。这些问题会污染模型能力判断，也会影响 SFT/RL 后模型是否真的更可靠的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对 15 个 1–8B open-weight 模型做多变体可靠性审计，主要分析覆盖 instruct 模型。每个任务使用五类 prompt variant：表面改写、指令顺序调整、3-shot、格式变化、隐式 framing。每个 model × dataset × variant cell 记录准确率、token-probability calibration、verbal-confidence calibration、verbal parse rate 和 prompt-perturbation spread。token confidence 通过 max_tokens=1 且 logprobs=200 的生成获得，主指标使用 label-set-normalized probability mass。verbal confidence 通过后续询问得到，并记录数值能否被解析。prompt spread 用非 format_change 变体中的最高和最低准确率之差衡量，以避免把 ARC-Challenge 上的格式解析问题混入普通鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 评测包含 SST-2、MNLI、AG News、ARC-Challenge、MMLU-Pro，每个 cell 评估 500 个样本。主要结果有三点。第一，评测定义会改变结论：ECE 从 raw token probability 改为 label-set-normalized probability 后，per-cell calibration 的平均绝对变化为 0.149。第二，prompt 和 evaluator 不匹配会制造假失败：在 ARC-Challenge 上，将 CoT prompt 与 first-character evaluator 配对会造成明显的准确率坍缩，更换 evaluator 后大部分恢复。第三，模型的显式置信度信号不稳：MMLU-Pro 上 verbal confidence 明显高于实际准确率和 token-probability confidence；某些模型在特定 prompt variant 上 verbal parse rate 会失败。参数量也不是 prompt 鲁棒性的可靠代理，1–8B 范围内较小模型可能比更大模型更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Methods 中五类 prompt variant、ECE 计算和 verbal confidence 采集方式；再看主结果中 ECE normalization sensitivity、ARC-Challenge prompt-evaluator mismatch、MMLU-Pro verbal overconfidence 三组实验。附录的 prompt 模板值得快速扫一遍，因为这类工作的结论很依赖模板和解析逻辑。方法段中 primary set 和主分析模型数量的表述需要与表格核对。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-prompt accuracy hides reliability failures in small language models, especially calibration errors, parseability failures, and instability under prompt perturbations.
summary_en.importance: The main value is evaluation hygiene. Models in the 1B–8B range are often used for local assistants, low-latency systems, and agent submodules, where reliability cannot be captured by one accuracy number. The study shows that evaluation choices can change the conclusion without changing the model. Calibration depends on whether probabilities are label-set normalized, and reasoning prompts can appear to fail when the evaluator is still written for first-character answers. These issues are also relevant for post-training comparisons, because they can make an SFT or RL model look more or less reliable for pipeline reasons.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study audits 15 open-weight models in the 1B–8B range, with the main reliability analysis focused on instruct models. It evaluates five benchmarks under five prompt variants: surface paraphrase, instruction reorder, 3-shot prompting, format change, and implicit framing. For each model–dataset–variant cell, it records accuracy, token-probability calibration, verbal-confidence calibration, verbal parse rate, and prompt-perturbation spread. Token confidence is collected with a one-token generation using logprobs, and the main calibration metric normalizes probability mass over the valid label set. Verbal confidence is elicited in a follow-up generation and separately checked for parseability. Prompt spread is computed from accuracy variation across non-format-change variants to avoid mixing an evaluator artifact into the robustness metric.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers SST-2, MNLI, AG News, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro, with 500 examples per model–dataset–variant cell. Three results are most useful. First, calibration estimates are sensitive to definition: changing ECE from raw token probability to label-set-normalized probability changes per-cell calibration by a mean absolute 0.149. Second, prompt–evaluator mismatch can create spurious failures: pairing a chain-of-thought ARC-Challenge prompt with a first-character evaluator causes a large apparent accuracy drop that is largely repaired by changing the evaluator. Third, confidence signals are fragile. On MMLU-Pro, verbal confidence is far above both accuracy and token-probability confidence, and verbal parseability can fail for a specific model and prompt variant. Parameter count is also a poor proxy for prompt robustness in this 1B–8B sample.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the methods for prompt variants, ECE definitions, verbal-confidence elicitation, and parse-rate filtering. Then read the results on calibration normalization sensitivity, ARC-Challenge evaluator mismatch, and MMLU-Pro verbal overconfidence. The appendix templates are worth checking because conclusions in this kind of audit depend heavily on exact prompts and parsing rules. The description of the primary model set should be cross-checked against the result tables, since the text uses slightly different language about the main analysis set.

recommendation.zh: 做 pretrain 的人不用通读；看评测协议错配那部分就够了，它提醒你很多“训练改进”其实可能只是 evaluator 在造假象。
recommendation.en: You do not need a full read; focus on the evaluator–prompt mismatch section, because it shows how many supposed training gains may just be scoring artifacts.

paper.title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital
paper.abstract: We study reliability in autonomous language-model agents that translate user mandates into validated tool actions under real capital. The setting is DX Terminal Pro, a 21-day deployment in which 3,505 user-funded agents traded real ETH in a bounded onchain market. Users configured vaults through structured controls and natural-language strategies, but only agents could choose normal buy/sell trades. The system produced 7.5M agent invocations, roughly 300K onchain actions, about $20M in volume, m

summary.core_problem: 在“真实资金约束”的长程自治LM代理中，如何把用户意图可靠地转成可验证、可结算的工具动作，并在大规模部署下保持低失败率。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是大规模真实部署与“operating layer”工程控制范式（验证、策略约束、状态管理）的经验数据；对pretrain本身间接，但对理解“模型能力 vs 系统约束”边界有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在DX Terminal Pro中用结构化控制+自然语言策略配置vault；代理只能执行受策略验证的买卖交易；通过操作层（prompt渲染、验证器、组合状态、结算管线等）把LM输出约束为可提交交易，并记录从mandate到链上结算的全链路trace。
summary.experiments: 21天线上部署：3505个用户资金代理、750万次agent调用、约30万次链上动作、约2000万美元交易量、约70B推理token、提交交易99.9%结算成功；包含长程序列决策（单agent 6000+循环）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make long-horizon autonomous LM agents reliably translate user intent into validated, settleable tool actions under real capital constraints at scale.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a large-scale real-world deployment and an 'operating layer' control pattern (validation, policy constraints, state management); indirect to pretraining but useful for separating model capability from system constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: DX Terminal Pro uses structured controls plus natural-language strategies to configure vaults; agents can only execute policy-validated trades; an operating layer (prompt rendering, validators, portfolio state, settlement pipeline) constrains LM outputs into submit-ready transactions and logs end-to-end traces.
summary_en.experiments: 21-day deployment: 3,505 user-funded agents, 7.5M invocations, ~300K onchain actions, ~$20M volume, ~70B inference tokens, 99.9% settlement success; long-running agents with 6,000+ prompt-state-action cycles.

recommendation.zh: 不是算法论文，但真实资金+长程trace很稀缺；只看系统约束/验证层如何把LM变“可结算动作”，别指望学到训练法。
recommendation.en: Not an algorithm paper, but real-capital long-horizon traces are rare; focus on how the validation/operating layer turns LM text into settleable actions, not on training insights.

paper.title: BenchGuard: Who Guards the Benchmarks? Automated Auditing of LLM Agent Benchmarks
paper.abstract: As benchmarks grow in complexity, many apparent agent failures are not failures of the agent at all - they are failures of the benchmark itself: broken specifications, implicit assumptions, and rigid evaluation scripts that penalize valid alternative approaches. We propose employing frontier LLMs as systematic auditors of evaluation infrastructure, and realize this vision through BenchGuard, the first automated auditing framework for task-oriented, execution-based agent benchmarks. BenchGuard cr

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂执行型 LLM agent benchmark 中，任务失败究竟来自模型能力不足还是 benchmark 规范、脚本与评测基础设施本身缺陷的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 审计工作，不直接改进预训练，但对 agent 评测可信度有现实价值。贡献主要是提出自动化审计框架，并实证说明现有知名 benchmark 中确实存在会误判模型能力的致命缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BenchGuard，用前沿 LLM 作为系统化审计器，对 benchmark 的任务说明、输入输出约束、执行脚本和评测逻辑做结构化交叉核验；可选地引入 agent 解答或执行轨迹作为额外诊断证据，以定位不可解任务、隐含假设、过于僵硬的评分脚本等问题。
summary.experiments: 在两个科学类 agent benchmark 上验证：在 ScienceAgentBench 中发现 12 个被作者确认的问题，其中包括使任务不可解的致命错误；在 BIXBench Verified-50 子集上，与专家识别问题的匹配率达到 83.3%，并发现部分人工审查遗漏的问题。摘要未给出更完整的模型配置与审计成本细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington Allen School、Phylo、Genentech。不是顶级实验室的基座研究论文，更像评测基础设施质量控制方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a basic but important question in execution-based LLM agent benchmarks: when an agent fails, is it a model failure or a benchmark infrastructure failure?
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark-auditing paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it matters for evaluation reliability. The main contribution is an automated auditing framework showing that prominent agent benchmarks contain defects severe enough to mis-measure model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: BenchGuard uses frontier LLMs as structured auditors to cross-check benchmark artifacts, including task specs, assumptions, execution scripts, and evaluation logic. It can optionally incorporate agent solutions or execution traces as extra evidence to diagnose unsolvable tasks, hidden assumptions, and overly rigid graders.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two scientific agent benchmarks: it found 12 author-confirmed issues in ScienceAgentBench, including fatal errors that make tasks unsolvable, and matched 83.3% of expert-identified issues on the BIXBench Verified-50 subset while catching issues missed by human review. The abstract does not provide full model/cost details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Washington Allen School, Phylo, and Genentech. This is better read as evaluation-infrastructure work than as frontier foundation-model research.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法论文，但如果你常拿 agent benchmark 做结论，这篇会提醒你先审 benchmark 再审模型；正文只看错误类型和人工一致性结果即可。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but if you use agent benchmarks to make capability claims, this is a useful reminder to audit the benchmark before blaming the model; the error taxonomy and human-agreement results are enough.

paper.title: ERA: Evidence-based Reliability Alignment for Honest Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds language models in factual evidence but introduces critical challenges regarding knowledge conflicts between internalized parameters and retrieved information. However, existing reliability methods, typically relying on scalar confidence, fail to explicitly distinguish between epistemic uncertainty and inherent data ambiguity in such hybrid scenarios. In this paper, we propose a new framework called ERA (Evidence-based Reliability Alignment) to enhanc

summary.core_problem: RAG里参数知识与检索证据冲突时，如何让模型更“诚实地拒答/保守回答”，并区分不确定性来源。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把RAG可靠性从标量置信度转向“证据分布+冲突度量”，属于对齐/可靠性方法；对预训练的直接启发有限，但对RAG系统的训练信号设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: ERA：用Dirichlet分布分别建模内部（参数）与外部（检索）证据的belief mass；再用Dempster-Shafer Theory量化两者几何冲突，用于校准置信与触发abstention。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的RAG任务、冲突构造方式、abstention指标（如coverage-risk曲线）与相对提升；需要核对是否只是后处理校准。

summary_en.core_problem: In RAG, when parametric knowledge conflicts with retrieved evidence, how to make models abstain more honestly and disentangle sources of uncertainty.
summary_en.importance: Shifts RAG reliability from scalar confidence to evidence distributions plus conflict measurement; useful for alignment/reliability in RAG, with limited direct pretraining impact.
summary_en.technical_approach: ERA models internal vs external evidence as independent Dirichlet belief masses, then uses Dempster–Shafer Theory to quantify geometric conflict and drive confidence/abstention decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete tasks, conflict construction, abstention metrics (e.g., risk-coverage), and gains; needs verification whether it is mostly post-hoc calibration.
summary_en.authors_note: Korea University, MPI-SP, KAIST, Gauss Labs

recommendation.zh: 把“参数vs检索”的冲突显式化是对的方向，但很可能是校准/后处理味道；读者只需盯住冲突构造、risk-coverage曲线和消融是否严格。
recommendation.en: Explicitly modeling parametric-vs-retrieved conflict is directionally right, but it may boil down to calibration/post-processing; focus on conflict setup, risk-coverage curves, and tight ablations.

paper.title: Hidden Reliability Risks in Large Language Models: Systematic Identification of Precision-Induced Output Disagreements
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed under diverse numerical precision configurations, including standard floating-point formats (e.g., bfloat16 and float16) and quantized integer formats (e.g., int16 and int8), to meet efficiency and resource constraints. However, minor inconsistencies between LLMs of different precisions are difficult to detect and are often overlooked by existing evaluation methods. In this paper, we present PrecisionDiff, an automated differential testing f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是一个部署侧但会反向影响训练与评测可信度的问题：同一个 LLM 在不同数值精度下推理，可能产生语义上不一致的输出，而且这种差异并不容易被常规 benchmark 或平均指标发现。作者特别关心的是安全对齐场景下的 precision-induced disagreement，也就是一个精度下拒答，另一个精度下却被越狱成功。核心问题不是量化是否会轻微掉点，而是精度变化会不会把模型推过某些脆弱决策边界，导致行为级别的分叉。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在两层。第一，它提醒人们训练、评测、部署三者之间存在一个常被忽略的接口：如果安全评测在 BF16 上做，线上却跑 FP16 或 INT8，那么“模型已通过评测”并不等于“部署行为一致”。第二，它把 precision robustness 从传统的数值误差问题提升到行为一致性问题，这对量化感知训练、蒸馏、低精度 serving、以及 safety eval 都有直接意义。严格说这不是 pretrain 方法论文，但它对后续训练目标设计和部署验证流程有明确启发，尤其适合做大模型训练与推理一体化的人看。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 PrecisionDiff，一个自动化 differential testing 框架。基本思想是把“同一模型的两种精度实现”视为两个待比较的程序实例，然后主动搜索能让它们输出分歧的输入。难点在于 LLM 输入是离散 token 序列，不像传统微分测试那样在连续空间里做扰动优化。为此，PrecisionDiff 设计了 dual-precision joint optimization：在一种精度下优化目标行为，在另一种精度下同时优化相反行为，从而把搜索过程推向两种实现的决策边界附近。论文在安全验证场景中的实例化是：构造 adversarial suffix，使模型在精度 A 下保持安全拒答，而在精度 B 下输出不安全内容。

从全文描述看，这个框架不只是简单套 GCG。它的关键区别是目标函数是“跨精度对比式”的，而不是单模型单目标攻击；因此搜索到的 suffix 更偏向 precision-sensitive trigger，而不是一般性的 jailbreak prompt。作者还做了 layer-wise divergence analysis，试图定位误差放大的关键层。结论是输入阶段、前部 attention、以及输出端模块更容易成为精度差异的放大点。这类分析虽然偏系统，但对训练侧也有启发：如果某些层对数值扰动特别敏感，那么量化策略、混合精度分配、甚至训练时的鲁棒性正则都可以更有针对性。
summary.experiments:
实验主要围绕安全对齐一致性展开。作者在五个开源对齐模型上测试，PrecisionDiff 检测 precision-induced jailbreak inconsistency 的成功率在 BF16 vs FP16 设置下平均为 84.0%，在 INT16 vs INT8 设置下平均为 99.5%。按模型看，成功率从 Llama-2 的 68.0% 到部分模型的 100.0% 不等，说明这不是个别模型的偶发现象。

和基线相比，PrecisionDiff 明显强于标准 GCG：在 Vicuna-7B 上检测成功率提升 1.4 倍，在 Llama-2-7B 上提升 8.5 倍。这个结果说明如果目标是发现“跨精度行为分歧”，单纯做常规 jailbreak 攻击并不够，因为它不会主动逼近 precision-specific boundary。论文还给出层级分析，指出输入层、初始 attention、输出末端是主要分歧放大位置，并据此建议 selective precision elevation。若从工程角度看，这比笼统地说‘关键层别量化’更具体一些。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看三块。第一看 PrecisionDiff 的目标函数和搜索流程，弄清楚它和普通 GCG、普通 differential testing 的区别。第二看主结果表，尤其是不同精度对、不同模型上的成功率；这里决定了问题是否足够普遍。第三看 layer-wise divergence analysis，判断作者的根因定位是否只是相关性描述，还是对部署策略真有指导意义。

如果时间有限，先读 Introduction、方法总图、主实验表、和层级分析图。预计 20 到 30 分钟能把主要信息抓住。阅读时要保持一个边界感：这篇更偏 reliability testing 与 deployment robustness，不是训练算法论文；它对预训练研究的价值主要来自‘评测与部署不一致会污染我们对模型能力和对齐状态的判断’这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a deployment-time reliability issue with direct implications for evaluation validity: the same LLM can produce semantically different outputs under different numerical precisions, and standard benchmarks often fail to surface those differences.
