The authors focus on safety alignment as the concrete case. A model may refuse under one precision but jailbreak under another. The question is not whether quantization causes a small average degradation. It is whether precision changes can push the model across fragile behavioral decision boundaries.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model work is twofold. First, it exposes a neglected interface between training, evaluation, and deployment. If safety evaluation is done in BF16 but production runs in FP16 or INT8, passing evaluation does not guarantee behavioral consistency after deployment. Second, it reframes precision robustness from a numerical-accuracy issue into a behavioral-consistency issue. That matters for quantization-aware training, mixed-precision serving, distillation, and safety verification. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to anyone building end-to-end training and inference pipelines for large models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes PrecisionDiff, an automated differential testing framework. The core idea is to treat two precision configurations of the same model as two separate implementations and actively search for inputs that make them disagree. The main challenge is that LLM inputs live in discrete token space, unlike prior differential testing work in continuous domains. To address this, the authors introduce a dual-precision joint optimization objective: optimize for a target behavior under one precision while simultaneously optimizing for the opposite behavior under the other precision. This drives the search toward precision-sensitive decision boundaries.

In the safety-alignment instantiation, the framework constructs adversarial suffixes that keep the model safely refusing under one precision while eliciting unsafe content under another. This is more specific than standard GCG-style jailbreak optimization. The objective is explicitly cross-precision and contrastive, so the discovered suffixes are tuned to expose precision-sensitive triggers rather than generic vulnerabilities. The paper also performs layer-wise divergence analysis to localize where small numerical differences get amplified. The reported hotspots are input-stage layers, early attention blocks, and output-end modules. Even though this part is more systems-oriented, it has training-side implications for mixed-precision allocation and robustness-aware optimization.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments center on safety-consistency verification. Across five aligned open-source LLMs, PrecisionDiff finds precision-induced jailbreak inconsistencies with an average success rate of 84.0% for BF16 vs FP16 and 99.5% for INT16 vs INT8. At the model level, success ranges from 68.0% on Llama-2 to 100.0% on some models, suggesting the issue is widespread rather than anecdotal.

Against baselines, PrecisionDiff substantially outperforms standard GCG: 1.4x higher detection success on Vicuna-7B and 8.5x on Llama-2-7B. That result is important because ordinary jailbreak attacks are not designed to target precision-specific boundaries. The layer-wise analysis further identifies input layers, initial attention mechanisms, and output-end modules as major amplification sites, motivating selective precision elevation instead of uniform high-precision fallback.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three things. First, read the PrecisionDiff objective carefully and compare it mentally with standard GCG and classic differential testing. The distinction is the main technical point. Second, inspect the main result tables across models and precision pairs to judge how pervasive the issue is. Third, read the layer-wise divergence analysis and ask whether it provides actionable deployment guidance or only post hoc correlation.

If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the method overview figure, the main evaluation tables, and the layer-wise analysis plots. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the contribution. The right framing is that this is primarily a reliability-testing and deployment-robustness paper. Its relevance to pretraining comes from the fact that evaluation under one precision and deployment under another can distort our conclusions about model capability and alignment.

recommendation.zh: 这不是预训练论文，但做量化/低精度部署的人该看：把“数值误差只是小噪声”的 prior 打了个洞，先读 alignment case 和 failure taxonomy。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but anyone deploying quantized models should read it: it punctures the prior that numerical error is just harmless noise; start with the alignment case and failure taxonomy.

paper.title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态LLM中视觉token剪枝（推理加速）对模型校准/置信度可靠性的影响，而不仅是准确率。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率策略的可靠性评测与经验规律总结；对部署与评估体系有价值，但对预训练方法论影响间接。
summary.technical_approach: 在不同token预算下，对多种剪枝策略（SCOPE不同saliency权重、saliency-only、FastV、random）进行系统对比，使用ECE、Brier、AURC等校准指标分析“效率-可靠性-准确率”关系，并做内部alpha sweep研究saliency权重对校准的影响。
summary.experiments: 基于LLaVA-1.5-7B，在POPE与ScienceQA-IMG上评测；发现剪枝并非简单牺牲可靠性换效率：在POPE上SCOPE的pure-coverage设置可显著降低ECE且准确率接近不剪枝；alpha-sweep显示降低saliency权重在各token预算下持续改善校准，准确率变化较小（摘要未给出完整数值表）。

summary_en.core_problem: Study how visual token pruning (for efficient inference) affects calibration/reliability in multimodal LLMs beyond task accuracy.
summary_en.importance: An empirical reliability evaluation of inference-efficiency techniques; useful for deployment and evaluation methodology, with indirect relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically compare pruning strategies (SCOPE with varying saliency weights, saliency-only, FastV, random) across token budgets using calibration metrics (ECE, Brier score, AURC), including an alpha sweep to analyze the effect of saliency weighting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluate LLaVA-1.5-7B on POPE and ScienceQA-IMG; pruning is not a simple reliability-efficiency tradeoff: on POPE, SCOPE pure-coverage yields substantially lower ECE with similar accuracy; lowering saliency weight consistently improves calibration across budgets with minor accuracy changes (full numbers not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 告诉你剪视觉token可能把校准搞坏/搞好但不提供可泛化机制，更多是评测提醒；扫一眼结论图和分任务分解即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly an evaluation warning that pruning can shift calibration in non-obvious ways without a unifying mechanism; glance at the headline plots and per-task breakdown.

paper.title: CircuitSynth: Reliable Synthetic Data Generation

summary.core_problem: LLM 用于结构化合成数据生成时，常出现幻觉、逻辑不一致与 mode collapse；现有 prompting/RAG/结构化采样方法难以同时给出“硬逻辑有效性保证”与“覆盖/公平等软分布约束的可控性与可量化”。
summary.importance: 高风险/强约束场景（KG-to-text、生物医学、法律等）里，单个逻辑维度出错或长尾维度缺失都会显著损害下游训练与评测；因此需要一种既保留语言表达能力、又能在语义层面提供形式化有效性与覆盖控制的可靠合成数据框架。
summary.technical_approach: CircuitSynth 采用“语义推理/表面实现”解耦的潜变量生成：先生成离散语义计划 z（实体类型、关系、属性配置等），再由条件 LLM 将 z 实现为文本 x。关键在于把 Teacher LLM 的语义推理能力蒸馏进可做精确推断的概率电路作为语义先验 P_Θ(z)：(1) 用 PSDD 作为带逻辑结构的可编译语义先验，通过 Logical Compilation 将硬约束直接编入电路拓扑，使无效状态在数学上不可达，从而实现 100% schema validity；(2) 为避免 mode collapse/提升长尾覆盖，在电路参数上用凸优化严格施加软分布约束（如公平性、稀有属性覆盖），并利用电路的精确边缘/条件推断去采样罕见属性组合；(3) 语言侧用 LLM 作为 neural realizer P_φ(x|z)，在“语义计划已满足约束”的前提下生成流畅文本；(4) 训练采用 Project-and-Distill：由 Teacher LLM 诱导/投影出满足 schema 的语义计划，再蒸馏到电路先验与生成流程中（文中还提到用 Einsum Networks 提升可扩展性）。
summary.experiments: 论文宣称在复杂逻辑基准上优于 SOTA：硬约束满足率达到 100%（由编译保证），并通过软约束优化缓解 mode collapse、提升稀有维度覆盖；对比对象包括无约束 LLM 采样、prompting/RAG、以及类似 TreeSynth 的结构化方法。由于给定全文片段未包含具体数据集/指标表格细节，建议在实验章节核对：有效性(Validity)、覆盖(Coverage/Long-tail)、分布匹配(如 KL/EMD)、以及文本质量(人工/自动指标)的量化结果与消融。
summary.reading_guide: skim（泛读）建议：1) Introduction：把握“LLM 作为生成器但不可控”的问题定义与动机；2) Methodology 总览与 Figure 1：理解 LVM 分解 P(z) 与 P(x|z) 以及为何选 PC/PSDD；3) 贡献点列表：硬约束编译 + 软约束凸优化 + Project-and-Distill。must_read（精读）建议：1) Methodology 中关于 PSDD/PC 的语义先验建模、Logical Compilation 如何把 schema/Φ 编进拓扑（这是 100% validity 的根因）；2) 软分布约束的凸优化形式：约束集合、目标函数、可行性与收敛/可解性假设，以及如何与电路参数化对应；3) “精确边缘推断→长尾采样”的实现细节与复杂度；4) Project-and-Distill：Teacher 生成语义计划的投影/过滤机制、蒸馏目标、以及与 realizer 的训练耦合；5) 实验部分重点看：与 TreeSynth/RAG/纯 LLM 的对比表、长尾覆盖曲线/分桶统计、以及硬约束违规率；6) Appendix A 理论分析：支持集受限、约束可满足性与推断可 tractable 的条件。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：LLM 擅长启发式语言生成但不擅长作为“概率控制器”；概率电路擅长可解释、可推断、可约束的语义分布控制但缺乏语言表现力。CircuitSynth 通过神经-符号分工，把“保证有效性与覆盖控制”前移到可编译/可优化的语义先验层，再把“自然语言表达”交给 LLM，从而同时获得形式化保证与可用文本。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLMs are used for structured synthetic data generation, they often hallucinate, violate logical constraints, and suffer from mode collapse. Existing prompting/RAG/structured sampling approaches lack a unified mechanism that provides both formal guarantees of validity (hard constraints) and controllable/quantifiable distributional coverage (soft constraints).
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes, constraint-heavy domains (KG-to-text, biomedical, legal), a single logical violation or missing long-tail configurations can severely degrade downstream training. A reliable framework must preserve linguistic expressivity while offering formal semantic validity and coverage control.
summary_en.technical_approach: CircuitSynth decouples semantic reasoning from surface realization via a latent-variable model: first sample a discrete semantic plan z, then realize text x with a conditional LLM P_φ(x|z). The key is a tractable semantic prior P_Θ(z) implemented as a probabilistic circuit: (1) a PSDD encodes logical structure; hard constraints are compiled into the circuit topology (Logical Compilation), making invalid states impossible and yielding 100% schema validity; (2) soft distributional constraints (e.g., fairness, rare-attribute coverage) are enforced directly on circuit parameters via convex optimization to mitigate mode collapse; (3) exact marginal/conditional inference in the circuit enables targeted sampling of rare attribute combinations; (4) a Project-and-Distill protocol uses a Teacher LLM to induce valid semantic plans and distill them into the circuit prior (with scalability mentions such as Einsum Networks).
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports outperforming state-of-the-art baselines on complex logical benchmarks: 100% validity (by compilation) and improved long-tail coverage via soft-constraint optimization, compared against unconstrained LLM sampling, prompting/RAG, and structured methods like TreeSynth. The provided excerpt does not include concrete dataset/metric tables; readers should verify in the experiments section the quantitative results for validity, coverage/long-tail statistics, distribution matching, and text quality, plus ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: skim: (1) Introduction for motivation and problem framing; (2) Methodology overview + Figure 1 to grasp the P(z) (PC/PSDD) vs P(x|z) (LLM) split; (3) Contributions list for the three pillars (hard compilation, soft convex constraints, Project-and-Distill). must_read: (1) PSDD/PC construction and how Logical Compilation embeds schema/Φ into topology (source of 100% validity); (2) the exact convex optimization formulation for soft constraints and its mapping to circuit parameters; (3) how exact marginal inference is used for long-tail sampling and its computational complexity; (4) Project-and-Distill details (teacher plan induction/projection, distillation losses, coupling with the realizer); (5) experiments: comparison tables, long-tail coverage plots/bucketed stats, constraint violation rates; (6) Appendix A theory: conditions for support restriction, satisfiability, and tractable inference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that LLMs are strong heuristic generators but weak probabilistic controllers, while probabilistic circuits provide exact inference and principled constraint handling but lack linguistic expressivity. CircuitSynth assigns formal validity and coverage control to a compiled/optimizable semantic prior, and delegates fluent language realization to an LLM, aiming to achieve both guarantees and usable text.

recommendation.zh: 当作合成数据“形式化约束+覆盖控制”的工具箱翻：看它如何把硬约束验证接到生成回路里；但别期待对预训练本身有直接新结论。
recommendation.en: Browse it as a toolbox for synthetic data with formal validity + coverage control: see how they wire constraint checking into generation loops, but don’t expect direct new takeaways for pretraining.

paper.title: Evaluating Reliability Gaps in Large Language Model Safety via Repeated Prompt Sampling

summary.core_problem: 论文关注传统LLM安全评测的“可靠性盲区”：像HELM、AIR-BENCH这类广度型基准通常对每个prompt只采样一次（或极少次），难以发现真实部署中“同一prompt反复调用”带来的操作性风险——例如偶发幻觉、拒答不一致、温度变化下偶尔越狱、同问不同答等。核心问题是：如何用统计上可解释的方式量化“重复采样下的失败频率”，从而评估部署级安全可靠性缺口。
summary.importance: 在高风险场景（金融、医疗、法律、治理、Agent系统）里，系统是否“偶尔”输出不安全内容往往比平均分更关键：一次越界就可能造成严重后果。单样本评测会系统性低估尾部风险与不稳定性。本文的重要性在于把可靠性工程里的加速应力测试思想迁移到LLM评测，提供一种面向LLMOps的、可量化比较的“深度评测”框架，用失败概率而非单次得分来刻画风险。
summary.technical_approach:
提出Accelerated Prompt Stress Testing（APST）：
- 深度导向：对同一prompt在受控条件下重复生成（多次采样），而不是追求任务覆盖面。
- 应力变量：系统性扫温度（temperature variation），并加入轻微prompt扰动（prompt perturbations），模拟真实使用中的重试、改写与解码参数变化。
- 统计建模：把每次生成视为独立推理事件，不假设时间退化或状态依赖；将“是否发生安全相关失败”视为Bernoulli事件，用二项分布/频率估计得到每类prompt或风险类别的经验失败概率，从而可比较不同模型与配置的可靠性。
- 与红队区别：红队是自适应地找最坏prompt，难以给出类别级、系统级的可解释失败频率；APST用结构化安全分类抽样prompt并重复采样，目标是统计可解释的风险估计。
summary.experiments: 论文在实验部分展示：在重复采样与温度扫掠下，失败呈现“结构化模式”——不同prompt、不同温度下的经验失败概率差异很大；即使传统基准分数相近，APST也能揭示可靠性差距。作者强调N≤3的低采样评测会掩盖这些差异。文中列举的失败模式包括：幻觉、事实不稳定、连贯性退化、护栏不一致（先拒后答/改写后答）、安全相关泄露或危险指导、该拒不拒等。Fig.1用于对比广度评测、对抗测试与APST的定位差异（建议重点看）。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读Introduction：抓住“单次采样评测无法反映部署风险”与APST三要素（重复采样、温度/扰动、失败概率）。
- 快速看Fig.1：理解APST与基准/红队的关系。
- 浏览§III（方法）：只需掌握把失败当Bernoulli、用二项统计估计频率的核心设定。
- 浏览§IV（结果）：看作者如何展示“同分不同险”（基准相近但失败率不同）的案例。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读§III：
  - 明确“操作条件”的定义：温度扫掠范围、扰动类型、重复次数N如何选；这些决定统计功效与成本。
  - 关注失败事件的判定口径（哪些算failure、如何标注/判别），因为Bernoulli建模的有效性取决于标签一致性。
  - 理解作者为何强调“独立推理事件”假设，以及在实际系统（缓存、工具调用、对话状态）下可能的偏离。
- 精读§IV：
  - 重点看失败概率随温度变化的曲线/表格（若有），以及prompt间方差：这是APST相对单样本评测的增益来源。
  - 关注作者如何做模型/配置间的可比性（相同prompt集、相同应力条件）。
- 创新点抓手：把可靠性工程的HAST思想落到LLM安全评测；用统计频率刻画“偶发但致命”的安全失败，并提出可用于LLMOps的评测流程。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调APST不是为了“找到最坏越狱prompt”，而是为了在结构化安全分类下估计失败发生的频率，从而服务部署决策（温度设置、重试策略、监控阈值、模型选型）。核心观点是：安全不仅是能力/覆盖问题，更是随机性与尾部风险管理问题；低采样评测会系统性漏检可靠性缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a reliability blind spot in standard LLM safety evaluation: breadth-oriented benchmarks (e.g., HELM, AIR-BENCH) typically sample each prompt once (or very few times), missing operational risks that arise when the same prompt is used repeatedly in deployment—sporadic hallucinations, inconsistent refusals, occasional jailbreaks under different temperatures, and instability across retries. The core question is how to quantify failure frequency under repeated sampling in a statistically interpretable way.
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes deployments (finance, healthcare, law, governance, agentic systems), an occasional unsafe output can dominate real-world risk even if average benchmark scores look good. Single-sample evaluation systematically underestimates tail risk and variability. The paper’s contribution is to adapt accelerated stress testing ideas from reliability engineering to LLM safety, producing deployment-oriented, quantitatively comparable estimates of failure probability rather than one-off scores.
summary_en.technical_approach:
It introduces Accelerated Prompt Stress Testing (APST):
- Depth-oriented evaluation: repeatedly generate outputs for identical prompts under controlled conditions.
- Stress variables: systematic temperature sweeps and small prompt perturbations to emulate real operational retries, paraphrases, and decoding changes.
- Statistical framing: treat each generation as an independent inference event (no temporal degradation assumed); model safety-relevant failures as Bernoulli events and use binomial/empirical frequency estimates to compare reliability across models and configurations.
- Positioning vs red-teaming: red-teaming adaptively searches for worst-case prompts but does not yield statistically interpretable category/system-level failure rates; APST samples prompts from structured safety taxonomies and estimates failure probabilities that generalize beyond individual prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments show that under repeated sampling and temperature stress, failures exhibit structured patterns: empirical failure probabilities vary substantially across prompts and temperatures, even when conventional benchmark scores appear similar. The paper argues that very-low-sample evaluation (N≤3) can hide meaningful safety reliability gaps. Reported failure modes include hallucinations, factual instability, degraded coherence at stress settings, guardrail inconsistency (refuse-then-comply under rephrasing/retries), security-relevant leakage or harmful assistance, and failure-to-refuse. Fig. 1 is used to clarify APST’s niche relative to breadth benchmarks and adversarial testing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read the Introduction for the thesis: single-sample benchmarks miss deployment risk; APST = repeated sampling + temperature/perturbation stress + failure probability.
- Look at Fig. 1 to understand how APST differs from benchmarks and red-teaming.
- Skim §III to capture the core modeling choice (Bernoulli failures, binomial frequency estimation).
- Skim §IV for the headline evidence that “similar benchmark scores can mask very different failure rates.”

【must_read】
- Deep-read §III:
  - Pin down the operational conditions: temperature ranges, perturbation types, and how repetition count N is chosen (cost vs statistical power).
  - Study how a “failure event” is defined and labeled/judged; the Bernoulli model’s usefulness depends on consistent failure criteria.
  - Understand the independence assumption and where real systems (caching, tool use, conversational state) might violate it.
- Deep-read §IV:
  - Focus on plots/tables of failure probability vs temperature and prompt-to-prompt variance—this is where APST adds value over single-sample evaluation.
  - Check how comparability across models/configs is ensured (same prompt sets, same stress conditions).
- Innovation lens: importing highly accelerated stress testing into LLM safety evaluation and reframing safety as stochastic tail-risk management with operationally actionable failure-rate estimates.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors emphasize APST is not about finding the single worst jailbreak prompt; it is about estimating failure frequency over structured safety categories to support deployment decisions (temperature settings, retry policies, monitoring thresholds, model selection). The key message is that safety is not only about capability/coverage but also about stochasticity and tail-risk; low-sample evaluations systematically miss reliability gaps.

recommendation.zh: 把安全评测从一次性打分改成失败概率估计；只看重复采样的统计口径与尾部风险对比，能直接落到LLMOps。
recommendation.en: Reframes safety eval from single-shot scores to failure-probability estimates; read the repeated-sampling statistics and tail-risk comparisons—directly actionable for LLMOps.

paper.title: Why Don't You Know? Evaluating the Impact of Uncertainty Sources on Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 不确定性量化（UQ）方法通常输出单一置信度分数，但自然语言任务的不确定性来源多样（知识缺口、输出多解/可变性、输入歧义等）。核心问题是：不同不确定性来源会如何影响各类 UQ 方法的行为与有效性？现有评测缺乏对来源的可控隔离，导致比较不公平。
summary.importance: 在医疗、法律、教育等高风险场景，系统需要根据“不确定性来源”采取不同动作：知识不足→检索/拒答；多解可变→给多个答案或解释多样性；输入歧义→追问澄清。若 UQ 分数无法区分来源，可能触发错误策略（例如把“多解”当成“不会”而拒答），直接影响安全性与用户体验。因此需要来源可控的数据与系统性评测来揭示方法盲点。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的关键技术贡献是构建一个“按不确定性来源成组控制”的评测数据集，并在该数据集上系统评估多类 UQ 方法。
- 不确定性来源最小集合：
(1) 知识不确定性（问题明确且单一正确，但模型可能不知道）；
(2) 输出可变性/多正确答案（问题明确但存在多个语义上不同的正确回答，概率质量分散导致采样输出不一致）；
(3) 输入歧义（问题欠指明，需澄清才能确定所问）。
- 数据集设计：以 triplets 组织问题，每个三元组在长度、格式、领域等方面尽量可比，仅改变不确定性来源，从而控制混杂因素，实现对 UQ 方法的公平对比；并进行人工验证。
- 评测范围：覆盖多种 UQ 家族（如基于 token 概率、基于一致性/自一致、verbalized 等）与多个模型，分析不同来源下的系统性失效模式与家族弱点。
summary.experiments: 在三类不确定性场景下，对多种 UQ 方法与三种模型进行对比评测，并做失败案例分析。论文强调的经验现象包括：一致性类方法可能把“多正确答案导致的输出不一致”误判为高不确定（尽管模型其实可以自信给出任一正确答案）；输入歧义会让“是否知道答案”的判定变得更困难，且更应触发澄清而非简单拒答；不同方法家族对不同来源呈现特定脆弱性。数据集与分析用于揭示这些差异并指导方法选择/系统策略。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（为何“来源”重要以及对应的系统动作；Figure 1 的决策映射）；Dataset Creation（triplet 设计如何隔离混杂因素；三类来源的操作化定义与构造流程；人工验证标准）；实验与失败案例分析（按来源分桶的对比结果，逐类总结哪些方法在何种来源下失效以及原因）。
- 重点图表/内容：Figure 1（不确定性来源→系统响应）；数据集统计与示例 triplets（理解“只变来源不变其他”的控制思想）；按来源拆分的性能表/校准曲线/相关性分析（如果文中提供）。
- 创新点核对：①来源可控的 triplet 数据集；②跨方法家族、跨模型的系统评测；③面向部署决策的失败模式归因。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + 贡献点列表（理解三类来源与动机）+ Dataset Creation 的三类定义段落（知道每类在问答里长什么样）+ 实验结论/讨论（抓住“哪些 UQ 方法在多解/歧义下会误报”的主结论）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张 UQ 不应只追求单一“正确性置信度”，而应关注不确定性来源，因为来源决定系统应对策略；并通过 triplet 控制数据集证明：很多现有 UQ 信号在不同来源下含义会发生偏移，导致方法比较与部署决策都可能被误导。

summary_en.core_problem: Most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods output a single confidence score, but uncertainty in language tasks comes from distinct sources (knowledge gaps, output variability with multiple valid answers, and input ambiguity). The paper asks: how do these sources affect the behavior and effectiveness of existing UQ methods, and how can we evaluate this fairly under controlled conditions?
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes deployments, the right system action depends on the uncertainty source: lack of knowledge → retrieve/abstain; multiple valid answers → present alternatives; ambiguous input → ask for clarification. If a UQ score conflates sources, systems may take harmful actions (e.g., abstain when the question simply has many correct answers). A source-controlled benchmark is necessary to diagnose method weaknesses and guide safe decision policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main technical contribution is a controlled evaluation dataset and protocol that isolates uncertainty sources.
- Minimal, operational source set:
(1) knowledge uncertainty (well-specified, single correct answer, model may not know);
(2) output variability / multiple correct answers (well-specified but many semantically distinct valid answers; probability mass spreads, sampled outputs disagree);
(3) input ambiguity (underspecified question requiring clarification).
- Dataset design: questions are organized into triplets; within each triplet, questions are made comparable in length/format/domain while differing primarily in uncertainty source, reducing confounds and enabling fair method comparison; human validation is performed.
- Evaluation: benchmark a broad set of UQ method families (token-probability-based, consistency-based, verbalized, etc.) across multiple models, and analyze source-specific failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates many UQ methods on the triplet dataset across three models, reporting performance by uncertainty source and providing failure-case analyses. Highlighted findings include: consistency-based methods can over-report uncertainty for the “multiple valid answers” scenario (treating semantic disagreement as ignorance); ambiguity makes it hard to interpret confidence as knowledge and should trigger clarification rather than abstention; different UQ families exhibit characteristic vulnerabilities depending on the source.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Key sections: Introduction (why sources matter; the source→system-action mapping, esp. Figure 1); Dataset Creation (how triplets control confounds; operational definitions and construction; human validation); Experiments + failure analysis (results stratified by source; method-family weaknesses and causal explanations).
- Key figures/tables: Figure 1 (uncertainty source to downstream action); dataset examples/statistics showing triplet control; per-source performance/calibration plots if provided.
- Innovation checklist: (i) source-controlled triplet dataset; (ii) systematic cross-family, cross-model UQ evaluation; (iii) deployment-oriented failure attribution.

skim (quick read):
- Read Introduction + contributions, the three source definitions in Dataset Creation, and the main results/discussion to capture the headline: many UQ signals change meaning across sources, especially for multi-answer and ambiguous inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue UQ should be source-aware because the source determines the appropriate system response. Their controlled triplet benchmark shows that many existing UQ methods conflate sources, making both method comparisons and deployment decisions potentially misleading.

recommendation.zh: 把UQ拆成可控来源后才看得出方法在“多解/歧义”上乱报置信度；只读实验设计与分解结果表即可校准你对UQ分数的信任边界。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the controlled source-factorization: it exposes when UQ scores conflate ambiguity/variability with ignorance; read the setup + main decomposition table to recalibrate how much you trust a single confidence number.

paper.title: When Verification Fails: How Compositionally Infeasible Claims Escape Rejection

summary.core_problem: 科学主张验证（claim verification）需要遵循闭世界假设（CWA）：只有当主张所断言的每个约束都被证据正向支持时才接受，否则应拒绝。本文指出：现有验证基准的负例构造方式（只扰动一个显著约束）使得“完整 CWA 检查所有约束”和一种更弱的捷径“显著约束检查（salient-constraint checking）”在行为上不可区分，导致我们误以为模型具备严格验证能力。核心问题是：模型到底在做全约束验证，还是只检查最显眼的那一条？
summary.importance: 在科学/医疗/临床试验、表格与图表等高风险场景，验证系统若采用捷径，会系统性放过“组合上不可行”的错误主张（看似每个局部都对，但组合关系不成立），从而造成严重误导。本文的重要性在于揭示了基准设计的结构性盲点，并提供能区分两种验证标准的对抗性评测设置，为后续训练与评测提供更可靠的靶标。
summary.technical_approach:
本文提出一个理论框架与一个新的负例构造设置来“拆穿”捷径。

(1) 形式化：给定证据集合 E={e1..em} 与 claim c，其断言约束集合 C(c)={c1..cn}。在 CWA 下，接受当且仅当所有约束都被证据正向支持；任何约束缺乏支持都应拒绝。

(2) 捷径定义：显著约束检查只挑选 claim 中最显著/最易检索的一条约束进行核验：若该约束被支持则倾向接受，否则拒绝。由于现有基准的负例通常只破坏这一条显著约束，捷径在负例上也能高分，从而与完整 CWA“看起来一样”。

(3) 组合不可行（compositionally infeasible）负例：构造一种对抗负例，使“显著约束”在证据中看似成立，但在非显著约束处引入违背，且该违背需要跨多个证据单元组合推理才能发现（例如两句临床文本的组合关系、图表中两段趋势的组合、表格中两列/多列的组合约束）。

(4) 构造算法：graph-based corrupt-and-propagate。直观上先保留显著观察（让最显眼的那条仍可被证据支持），再通过在证据图结构上“腐化并传播”引入组合层面的矛盾，使得只有执行全约束检查（含组合约束）才能拒绝。

(5) 诊断与干预：作者还测试了 test-time guidance（闭世界指令、显式分解等）。结果显示这些干预更多是在 ROC 上移动阈值/权衡（改变接受-拒绝倾向），而非真正解决组合负例上的推理瓶颈。并引入 rubric-based LLM judge 对推理轨迹打分，评估是否逐条检查约束或在显著约束处提前终止，从“过程”层面验证失败机制。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖三类既有基准：NLI4CT（临床试验文本）、SCITAB（科学表格）、SciVer（图表）。关键现象：模型在“标准负例（单显著扰动）”上拒绝率/准确率高，但在“组合不可行负例（对抗负例）”上会显著更容易接受（over-acceptance），且该差距跨模型家族与规模都存在。作者还报告：闭世界指令与显式分解等测试时引导并未整体提升对抗负例表现，而是改变了接受/拒绝的 tradeoff；rubric judge 的轨迹评分进一步显示模型经常在检查显著约束后提前停止，符合“显著约束检查”而非完整 CWA。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- Introduction：重点读 Figure 1 的对比（现有负例 vs 组合不可行负例）以及“为何现有基准无法区分 CWA 与捷径”的论证链。
- Theoretical Framework：精读 CWA 的形式化、约束集合 C(c) 的定义、以及 salient-constraint checking 的程序化刻画；这是全文的概念地基。
- 数据构造方法（graph-based corrupt-and-propagate）：这是论文最关键的技术贡献之一，建议对照案例理解“保留显著约束、在非显著组合处造假”的具体操作。
- 实验主结果（Figure 2 等）：关注三基准上标准负例 vs 对抗负例的接受率差距，以及跨模型/规模一致性。
- 干预实验 + rubric-based judge：这是作者证明“推理瓶颈而非策略选择”的证据链，建议精读评分维度与典型失败轨迹。

skim（泛读）：
- 读 Abstract + Introduction 前两页，抓住：基准盲点→捷径→组合不可行负例。
- 快速浏览构造方法的高层描述与 1-2 个示例即可。
- 直接看主结果图表（标准负例 vs 对抗负例差距）与结论段，理解论文主张与影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：当前科学验证评测“看起来很强”的负例准确率，可能只是模型在做显著约束检查这一捷径；只有引入组合不可行负例，才能真正测试闭世界式的全约束验证能力。并且简单的提示词/分解并不能根治该问题，说明瓶颈更像是组合约束的系统性推理缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Scientific claim verification should follow the Closed-World Assumption (CWA): accept a claim iff every constraint it asserts is positively supported by the evidence; otherwise reject. The paper argues existing benchmarks build negative examples by perturbing a single salient element, making full CWA indistinguishable from an easier shortcut—salient-constraint checking—that verifies only the most salient constraint. The key question: are models truly enforcing CWA, or just checking the most prominent constraint?
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes domains (clinical trials, scientific tables, charts), shortcut verification can systematically let through claims that are locally plausible but globally impossible when constraints are composed across evidence units. The paper exposes a structural benchmark blind spot and introduces an evaluation setting that can separate genuine exhaustive verification from shortcut behavior, improving the reliability of both evaluation and future training targets.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper contributes a formal distinction and an adversarial negative construction.

(1) Formalization: Given evidence pieces E={e1..em} and a claim c asserting constraints C(c)={c1..cn}, CWA accepts iff all constraints are supported; lack of support for any constraint implies rejection.

(2) Shortcut: salient-constraint checking selects the most salient/easiest-to-retrieve constraint and decides based only on it—reject if it is violated, accept if it appears supported.

(3) Compositionally infeasible claims (adversarial negatives): Construct negatives where the salient constraint is supported by the evidence, but a non-salient constraint is violated in a way that requires compositional reasoning across multiple evidence units (e.g., combining two sentences, two chart trends, or multiple table columns).

(4) Construction algorithm: a graph-based corrupt-and-propagate procedure that preserves salient observations while introducing violations through composed relationships within the same evidence source.

(5) Diagnosis and interventions: Evaluate test-time guidance toward CWA (closed-world instructions, explicit decomposition). These interventions mainly shift the accept/reject tradeoff (movement along the ROC curve) rather than solving adversarial negatives. A rubric-based LLM judge scores reasoning traces for CWA compliance (checking all constraints vs early stopping at the salient one), providing process-level evidence of the shortcut.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations span three established benchmarks: NLI4CT (clinical trial text), SCITAB (scientific tables), and SciVer (charts). Main finding: models achieve high accuracy on standard negatives but accept compositionally infeasible adversarial negatives at much higher rates (systematic over-acceptance), and this gap persists across model families and scales. Test-time CWA guidance does not materially improve adversarial-negative performance overall, instead trading off acceptance vs rejection. Rubric-based trace scoring shows models often terminate after verifying the salient constraint, consistent with salient-constraint checking rather than full CWA.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Introduction: study Figure 1’s contrast (standard negatives vs compositionally infeasible negatives) and the argument for benchmark indistinguishability.
- Theoretical Framework: carefully read the CWA formalization, constraint-set definition, and the procedural definition of salient-constraint checking.
- Data construction (graph-based corrupt-and-propagate): this is a core technical contribution; read with examples to understand how salience is preserved while compositional violations are injected.
- Main results (e.g., Figure 2): focus on the standard-vs-adversarial gap across all three benchmarks and across model scales.
- Interventions + rubric-based judge: key evidence that the issue is a reasoning bottleneck, not merely a strategy choice.

skim (quick read):
- Read Abstract + first two pages of Introduction for the benchmark-blind-spot narrative.
- Skim the high-level construction description and a couple of examples.
- Jump to the main results figures/tables and conclusion for the headline empirical claim and implications.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s message: strong performance on existing verification benchmarks may reflect a shortcut (salient-constraint checking) rather than true closed-world, all-constraints verification. Compositionally infeasible adversarial negatives are necessary to test CWA compliance, and prompt-based guidance alone does not fix the underlying compositional reasoning bottleneck.

recommendation.zh: 它戳破“验证模型会做CWA全约束检查”的默认想象：很多只是在查最显眼约束；只看对抗负例构造与错误类型统计就能改评测prior。
recommendation.en: It breaks the comforting prior that claim verifiers do full CWA-style constraint checking—many just check the salient constraint; skim the adversarial negative construction and the error breakdown.

paper.title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 有状态的工具调用型 LLM 智能体把上下文窗口当作工作内存，但现有 agent harness 对“状态驻留（residency）与持久性（durability）”的管理多为 best-effort：压缩/裁剪后关键状态丢失、reset 时绕过 flush、写回覆盖式破坏（destructive writeback）。这些问题导致重复工具调用、偏好/约束丢失、计划中断且难以诊断与复现。
summary.importance: 随着智能体运行时长从分钟扩展到小时/天、跨多轮上下文窗口与多 session，状态管理成为可靠性的决定因素。仅靠检索质量提升、摘要压缩调参或外部记忆插件无法提供可执行的契约：什么必须保留、何时必须落盘、丢失如何可观测。作者主张应像操作系统管理内存一样，把“上下文=物理内存、外部存储=磁盘”的问题上升为虚拟内存机制，并在 harness 层强制执行。
summary.technical_approach:
ClawVM：一种由 harness 管理的“虚拟内存层”，核心设计包括：
(1) Typed pages：把 agent 状态拆成带类型的页面（而非自由文本块），便于策略化管理与验证。
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants：每页定义最低保真不变量（在 token 预算压力下最多可降级到什么程度），避免 compaction 把关键状态降到不可用。
(3) Multi-resolution representations：同一页可在多分辨率/多表示间切换（全量细节→压缩→结构化字段→指针），实现“渐进降级”而非全有或全无。
(4) Staged, validated writeback：在每个生命周期边界（compaction/pruning/reset 等）执行分阶段、可验证、非破坏性的写回协议，防止 flush 被绕过与覆盖式写回。
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay：当不变量被破坏或状态丢失时触发可观测 fault，使问题可诊断、可回放；并用 offline oracle（具备未来需求知识）分析在线策略是否仍有改进空间。
summary.experiments: 在合成工作负载、12 条真实 session trace、对抗压力测试与 OpenClaw 派生工作负载上评估：ClawVM 将“策略可控的 faults”（refetch、duplicate-tool、post-compaction bootstrap、flush-miss）从检索基线的平均 67.8/配置、以及“实践者调参的 compaction+retrieval”基线的 1.5/配置降到 0；paging instability 分别降低 77.4% 与 11.4%。在最紧 token 预算下，30 个任务级回放成功率 100%（对比实践者基线 76.7%）。策略引擎开销中位数 <50 微秒/turn。离线 oracle 显示在线策略已达最优 fault 数（零剩余 headroom）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（把 harness 视作“agent OS kernel”的论证与问题分类）；方法章节中关于 typed pages、minimum-fidelity invariants、multi-resolution 表示的形式化定义与示例；writeback 协议（如何做到 validated、non-destructive、覆盖所有 lifecycle boundary）；fault model 与 deterministic replay（如何让错误可观测、可回归测试）；offline oracle 分析（如何证明在线策略已最优）。
- 重点图表/结果：Figure 1（整体架构与数据流）；fault 类型统计与归零结果；不同 token budget 下的稳定性/成功率曲线；开销评估（<50μs/turn）。
- 创新点抓手：①把“记忆管理契约”上移到 harness 强制执行（而非靠模型提示/插件）；②最低保真不变量 + 多分辨率页面实现可控降级；③生命周期边界的分阶段验证写回，避免 destructive overwrite；④可观测 fault + 可确定性回放 + oracle 上界分析，形成可审计、可回归的工程闭环。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + Contributions（问题与方案一页抓住）；再扫 Background（为何现有 pruning/retrieval/compaction 不够）；然后直接看实验主表（fault=0、成功率提升、开销）；最后快速浏览 writeback 与 fault model 的小节以理解“为什么能保证”。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：状态可靠性不是“更好的检索/更长的上下文/更聪明的摘要”能根治的，而需要像 OS 虚拟内存一样的可执行契约与故障模型；且唯一合适的强制点在 harness（它天然掌控 prompt 组装、工具调用与生命周期事件）。论文贡献更偏系统与工程可验证性：用不变量、写回验证、可观测 fault 与确定性回放，把智能体记忆从启发式调参变成可审计的运行时机制。

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Software SystemsSaarbrücken, Saarland

summary_en.core_problem: Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory, but today’s agent harnesses manage state residency and durability on a best-effort basis. This causes recurring failures: critical state is lost after compaction, flushes are bypassed on reset, and writeback can be destructive (overwrite instead of merge). The result is repeated tool calls, lost preferences/constraints, broken plans, and failures that are hard to diagnose or reproduce.
summary_en.importance: As agents run for hours/days across multiple context windows and sessions, state management becomes the dominant reliability bottleneck. Improving retrieval quality, tuning compaction, or adding memory plugins does not provide an enforceable contract for what must remain resident, what must be durable, and how losses become observable. The paper argues for an OS-style framing—context as physical memory, external stores as disk—and for enforcing virtual-memory-like guarantees at the harness layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ClawVM is a harness-managed virtual memory layer with:
(1) Typed pages: agent state is managed as typed pages rather than free-form text.
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants: each page declares how far it may degrade under token pressure.
(3) Multi-resolution representations: pages can gracefully degrade (full detail → compressed → structured fields → pointer) instead of all-or-nothing compaction.
(4) Staged, validated writeback: deterministic, non-destructive commits at every lifecycle boundary (compaction/pruning/reset), preventing bypassed flushes and destructive overwrites.
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay: invariant violations/state loss raise explicit faults, making issues diagnosable and replayable; an offline oracle (with future demand knowledge) is used to assess optimality/headroom.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on synthetic workloads, 12 real-session traces, adversarial stress tests, and OpenClaw-derived workload families. ClawVM eliminates all policy-controllable faults (refetch, duplicate-tool, post-compaction bootstrap, flush-miss): from 67.8 mean faults per workload-budget configuration (retrieval baseline) and 1.5 (practitioner-tuned compaction+retrieval) down to 0. Paging instability is reduced by 77.4% and 11.4% respectively. At the tightest token budget, task-level replay success is 100% vs 76.7% for the practitioner baseline. Median policy-engine overhead is <50 μs per turn. Offline oracle analysis indicates the online policy already achieves the optimal fault count (no remaining headroom).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: Introduction (harness as an “agent OS kernel” and failure taxonomy); the formal design of typed pages, minimum-fidelity invariants, and multi-resolution representations; the staged validated writeback protocol across lifecycle boundaries; the fault model and deterministic replay methodology; offline oracle analysis for optimality.
- Key figures/results: Figure 1 (system overview); fault breakdown and the “faults to zero” results; curves across token budgets; overhead measurements (<50 μs/turn).
- Innovation checklist: (i) enforceable memory contract at the harness (not via prompts/plugins); (ii) invariants + multi-resolution pages for controlled degradation; (iii) validated non-destructive writeback at lifecycle boundaries; (iv) observable faults + deterministic replay + oracle upper bound for auditability and regression.

skim (overview):
- Read Introduction + Contributions; skim Background to see why pruning/retrieval/compaction are insufficient; jump to the main experimental tables (fault=0, success gains, overhead); then skim writeback and fault-model sections to understand the guarantees.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that agent memory reliability cannot be solved by “better retrieval/longer context/smarter summaries” alone; it requires an OS-like, enforceable runtime contract and a fault model. The harness is the natural enforcement point because it already controls prompt assembly, tool mediation, and lifecycle events. The contribution is primarily systems engineering with verifiable guarantees: invariants, validated writeback, observable faults, and deterministic replay turn memory management from heuristic tuning into an auditable runtime mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 值得看其“虚拟内存式契约”定义：把状态丢失从提示工程问题升级为 harness 责任边界；动作是按 residency/durability 做可观测与强制 flush。
recommendation.en: Worth it for the “virtual-memory contract” framing: it shifts state loss from prompt hacks to harness responsibility; actionable takeaway is to enforce observable residency/durability + mandatory flush semantics.

paper.title: Confident in a Confidence Score: Investigating the Sensitivity of Confidence Scores to Supervised Fine-Tuning

summary.core_problem: SFT 后常用不确定性/置信度分数与输出质量的相关性会退化，导致置信度无法可靠指示幻觉或错误。
summary.importance: 原理分析/评测贡献：揭示“置信度可直接复用”的隐含假设在后训练（SFT）后不成立，指出置信度变化可能来自分布相似性等非质量因素，为对齐/后训练阶段的可靠性评估与校准提供直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: 系统性比较多种置信度/不确定性指标在 SFT 前后的行为变化，分解相关性退化的来源：置信度分数不仅反映答案质量，还会被输出与训练分布的相似度等因素驱动；并通过下游任务案例展示“未校准的置信度”如何降低实际效用。
summary.experiments: 基于论文摘要信息：对多种 confidence scores 在 SFT 前后做相关性分析，并给出一个下游任务 case study 证明误相关会带来性能/效用下降；未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据规模、基线与定量提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: After supervised fine-tuning, commonly used confidence/uncertainty scores can become less correlated with output correctness, undermining their reliability for detecting hallucinations or errors.
summary_en.importance: The paper provides an evaluation/analysis warning that confidence scores are not automatically transferable across post-training stages; it shows that post-SFT confidence can be driven by factors other than quality (e.g., similarity to the training distribution), motivating recalibration and more careful reliability assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: It systematically compares multiple confidence/uncertainty measures before and after SFT, decomposing why correlation with quality degrades and demonstrating that confidence reflects both answer quality and distributional similarity; it further illustrates downstream consequences when uncalibrated confidence is used in decision-making.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments include correlation analyses of several confidence scores pre- vs post-SFT and a downstream case study showing reduced utility due to miscalibrated confidence; the abstract does not provide model/data specifics or detailed quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 结论不复杂但很实用：SFT 会把置信度分数的语义搞乱，别再把 logprob/entropy 当现成质量指示器；扫一眼敏感性实验和失败模式分类就够了。
recommendation.en: Not deep, but operationally important: SFT can scramble what your confidence score means, so stop treating logprob/entropy as plug-and-play quality signals; glance at the sensitivity experiments and failure-mode taxonomy.

paper.title: Every Response Counts: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Tensor Decomposition

summary.core_problem: 如何对LLM多智能体系统（MAS）在多轮交互/多路径通信下的整体推理轨迹不确定性进行可分解、可量化的评估。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为方法创新+可靠性评估：指出单轮输出UQ不适用于MAS，并将不确定性来源拆解为“多步级联”“通信路径变动”“拓扑多样性”等可分析因素，为多智能体系统的可靠性度量与调试提供统一框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MATU：不只看最终文本，而是将每次执行的完整推理轨迹表示为embedding矩阵；将多次运行（不同随机性/不同通信路径/不同拓扑）堆叠成高阶张量；通过张量分解（tensor decomposition）将观测到的变化分解为不同不确定性来源的成分，并据此给出量化指标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、对比基线与定量提升幅度；仅能确认其评测围绕多次运行的MAS轨迹与不同通信拓扑/路径设置展开。

summary_en.core_problem: Quantify and decompose uncertainty in LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) over full multi-turn interaction trajectories, where randomness, communication paths, and topology changes jointly affect outcomes beyond single-response uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.importance: Argues that conventional one-shot uncertainty measures are inadequate for MAS and provides a unified, analyzable framework that attributes uncertainty to factors such as multi-step cascading effects, path variability, and topology diversity, aiding reliability assessment and debugging.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MATU: represent each run’s full reasoning/interaction trajectory as an embedding matrix, stack multiple runs (varying seeds, paths, and topologies) into a higher-order tensor, and apply tensor decomposition to separate observed variation into components corresponding to distinct uncertainty sources, yielding quantitative uncertainty indicators.
summary_en.experiments: Studies uncertainty across repeated MAS executions under different communication paths and topologies; the abstract does not specify models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: UQ用张量分解拆MAS不确定性挺新，但可复现性取决于轨迹采样与拓扑设定；只看分解项定义和验证实验。
recommendation.en: Tensor-decomposition UQ for MAS is novel-ish, but reproducibility hinges on trajectory sampling/topology choices; focus on factor definitions and validation experiments.
